title: Welder/Fabricator
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
A Welder/Fabricator in a Steel Engineering Company plays a crucial role in the process of turning raw steel materials into usable components for various construction and engineering projects. Their responsibilities encompass a range of tasks related to cutting, shaping, assembling, and welding steel pieces to create structural and architectural elements. Key roles and responsibilities of a Steel Fabricator: Material Preparation: Review engineering drawings, blueprints, and specifications to understand the required dimensions and tolerances. Select appropriate steel materials based on project requirements and specifications. Measure and mark steel pieces for cutting and shaping using tools such as tape measures, squares, and marking devices. Cutting and Shaping: Operate various cutting equipment, such as saws, shears, plasma cutters, and torches, to cut steel pieces according to the provided specifications. Use bending machines, presses, and rollers to shape steel components as required by the design. 3. Welding and Assembly: Assemble steel components by welding, bolting, riveting, or other joining methods specified in the engineering plans. Perform welding using different techniques such as MIG (Metal Inert Gas), TIG (Tungsten Inert Gas), and stick welding, ensuring strong and durable connections. Ensure proper alignment, fit, and finish of assembled components, maintaining structural integrity and aesthetic appearance. Quality Control: Inspect fabricated parts for accuracy, quality, and conformance to specifications. Identify and address any defects, inconsistencies, or imperfections in the fabrication process. Conduct quality checks using measuring tools like calipers, gauges, and squares. Safety and Compliance: Adhere to safety protocols and guidelines while working with heavy machinery, cutting tools, and welding equipment. Wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) to ensure personal safety and prevent workplace accidents. Follow industry standards and regulations to ensure that the fabricated components meet required codes and standards. Collaboration: Communicate with engineers, designers, and other team members to clarify design details and resolve any issues that arise during fabrication. Collaborate with other fabricators and tradespeople to coordinate the assembly and installation of larger structures. Maintenance and Troubleshooting: Perform routine maintenance on fabrication equipment to ensure proper functioning and longevity. Troubleshoot and address equipment malfunctions or breakdowns to minimize downtime. Documentation: Maintain accurate records of materials used, time spent, and work completed for each project. Document any modifications or changes made during the fabrication process. Continuous Learning: Stay updated on advancements in fabrication techniques, equipment, and materials to enhance skills and knowledge.

title: supervisore dei cantieri edili
description: Per conto di LPM Prefabbricati (https://www.lpmpref.it/) storica azienda con presenza consolidata sul mercato italiano nella fabbricazione di prefabbricati di grandi dimensioni, ricerchiamo un* Geometra con circa 10 anni di esperienza per un ruolo di Responsabile di Commessa con forte presenza in cantiere. La figura seguirà la commessa e il cantiere quotidianamente: pianificazione montaggi, coordinamento risorse, relazione con il cliente e controllo di tempi/costi, garantendo l'esecuzione efficace dei lavori. Obiettivo del ruolo e responsabilità principali: Assicurare che ogni commessa venga gestita con rispetto di tempi, contratti e consegne, mantenendo un presidio operativo sul cantiere e guidando squadre e fornitori con metodo, disciplina e orientamento al risultato. In particolare: Pianificazione delle commesse: organizzare il susseguirsi dei cantieri sul lungo periodo, in base alle scadenze contrattuali, durata dei cantieri, ecc. Pianificazione montaggi prefabbricati: programmare le attività dall'avvio del cantiere al termine del montaggio. Programmare gli step operativi giornalieri/settimanali, e seguire l'avanzamento dei lavori. Coordinamento squadre di cantiere e subappaltatori: organizzazione, controllo operatività, gestione comportamenti e standard (es. riduzione inefficienze). Interfaccia con clienti: gestione richieste e criticità con approccio pratico (es. rimodulare l'ordine di montaggio per rispettare esigenze del cliente senza perdere controllo su tempi/costi). Controllo tempi / contratti / spedizioni: presidio consegne, vincoli contrattuali, varianti ed extra. Valutazione e controllo costi: stime, consuntivi, supporto alla marginalità e gestione economica della commessa. Topografia e rilievi di cantiere: tracciamenti, verifiche quote/dimensioni e controllo esecutivo (in coordinamento con ufficio tecnico/DL dove previsto). Collaborazione continua con ufficio tecnico, produzione e logistica per garantire continuità tra prefabbricazione e montaggio. Requisiti: Diploma di Geometra (o titolo tecnico equivalente). ~10 anni di esperienza in cantieri industriali con responsabilità di capocantiere, o responsabile operativo, o responsabile commessa. Preferibile esperienza in prefabbricati o provenienza da imprese di costruzioni Competenze di pianificazione, gestione priorità, avanzamento lavori e controllo economico. Disponibilità a trasferte su Nord-Ovest Italia e occasionalmente Sud Francia. Leadership concreta e capacità di gestione del team, capacità di far rispettare regole, sicurezza e metodi di lavoro. Ottima relazione con clienti e stakeholder: comunicazione chiara, negoziazione, problem solving. Approccio pratico, orientato a risultato e affidabilità su tempi/consegne. Azienda: LPM Srl Area: Mondovì (CN) e dintorni - raggio 40-45 km Cantieri: Nord-Ovest Italia + occasionali trasferte Sud Francia Contratto: Tempo indeterminato - Full time RAL indicativa: 40.000-50.000 € (commisurata all'esperienza) Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Migliorare processi commerciali (pricing, marginalità, standard offerta, governance sconti). Requisiti = 5 anni in ruoli commerciali B2B, preferibilmente in contesti tecnici/industriali o vendita consulenziale. Utilizzo concreto del CRM per pipeline, attività e monitoraggio risultati. Capacità di contribuire a budget commerciale, lettura KPI e attivazione di azioni correttive. Buona padronanza di pricing, gestione offerte, scontistica e condizioni commerciali. Attenzione a marginalità e redditività, bilanciando crescita e tutela dei margini. Esperienza (anche su piccoli team) in coordinamento e leadership. Inglese buono (scritto e parlato). Disponibilità a trasferte nazionali. Plus: provenienza da automazione industriale, componentistica elettrica/elettronica, sicurezza industriale. title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e creare sinergie commerciali a mercato per l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture. Ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Responsabilità principali - Definire roadmap, posizionamento e 'pacchetti' dei servizi commerciali satellite enabled. - Disegnare e lanciare offerte wholesale: modelli di partnership, livelli di servizio (SLA) e pricing. - Raccogliere esigenze da clienti/partner e tradurle in requisiti operativi e deliverable per i team coinvolti. - Identificare verticali prioritari, sviluppare opportunità commerciali e portare i pilot a contratti ricorrenti. - Selezionare e validare componenti e partner necessari all'erogazione del servizio (dispositivi/terminali e servizi di piattaforma/ground). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale Location: Milano, Italia Package: RAL 70-100K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio #LI-CP Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. title: supervisore di contact center
description: Per grande azienda industriale, ricerchiamo un Senior IT Service Desk che contribuirà alla continuità operativa degli uffici e degli stabilimenti produttivi, assicurando un supporto informatico tempestivo ed efficace agli utenti. La posizione prevede un ruolo operativo, con autonomia nella gestione delle richieste e capacità di definire le priorità in funzione dell'impatto sulle attività aziendali e sulla produzione. Le principali attività Fornire supporto IT di primo livello su PC, laptop, telefoni, periferiche, stampanti e dispositivi utilizzati negli stabilimenti, incluse le stampanti per etichette. Installare, configurare e sostituire hardware e software standard, supportando gli utenti nell'utilizzo delle applicazioni aziendali. Gestire richieste e incidenti tramite Jira, effettuando una prima diagnosi e indirizzando le problematiche ai team specialistici o ai fornitori quando necessario. Supportare onboarding e offboarding IT, predisponendo postazioni e accessi di base. Collaborare con i team IT locali e di gruppo, nel rispetto delle procedure aziendali e delle policy di sicurezza. Il profilo che cerchiamo Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Service Desk o Help Desk, indicativamente di 5-7 anni. Buona conoscenza di Windows client, Microsoft 365 e delle attività di troubleshooting hardware e software. Conoscenza di base di Active Directory, sistemi di stampa e connettività LAN e Wi-Fi. Familiarità con strumenti di ticketing, assistenza remota e principi di sicurezza informatica. Capacità di lavorare in autonomia, comunicare con utenti di diverse funzioni e gestire le priorità con un approccio pratico e orientato al servizio. Diploma tecnico o formazione equivalente in ambito informatico. Conoscenza della lingua inglese adeguata all'interazione con colleghi e team IT di gruppo. title: segretario/segretaria
description: On behalf of the Italian Entrepreneurial Holding of a growing international Group, we are looking for a Consolidation & Reporting Manager. Reporting directly to the Corporate Finance Manager, this is a stand-alone role. The successful candidate will actively contribute to building Group accounting processes and must possess comprehensive knowledge of IFRS principles. Key Responsibilities Preparation of monthly and annual consolidated financial statements, including adjusting and consolidation entries. Reconciliation of intercompany accounts and elimination entries, including the investigation and resolution of reconciliation variances. Management of changes in the consolidation scope, including acquisitions, mergers, takeovers, and corporate reorganizations. Support in accounting for Purchase Price Allocation (PPA), goodwill, and consolidation differences, where applicable. Analysis of data submitted by subsidiaries, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency, and managing detailed follow-up requests. Support in preparing the consolidated Notes to the Financial Statements and documentation for auditors and corporate governance bodies. Liaison with the administrative teams of foreign subsidiaries, providing support for accounting and administrative activities. Requirements Degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in Group Consolidation, Financial Reporting, External Audit, or Corporate Accounting. Previous experience within multinational listed companies or top-tier audit and advisory firms. Strong knowledge of IAS/IFRS Proven ability to manage complex reporting activities under tight deadlines Fluent English, both written and spoken, used regularly in a professional environment. Knowledge of USGAAP and experience with Oracle are a plus Offer Permanent employment Contract RAL between €50,000 and €60,000 1 day of remote working per week #LI-AM2

title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
description:
.....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.

Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt
- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich
- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour
- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

Interesse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Grundkenntnisse: Gästebetreuung, Fahrzeugführung, Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Technisches Verständnis

From Germany and our locations in Asia, we advise and support international clients in several sectors such as advertising, photography, trade and industry. 3D Production Manager (m/f/d)
Hanoi, Vietnam, Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm

- Leadership of a motivated 3D production team (Home & Living, Fashion, Retail Industry)
- Oversee daily 3D asset production operations, ensuring smooth delivery and efficient workflows
- Building, developing and motivating the team in Hanoi

- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner
- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability
- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style
- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness
- Fluent English (business level)
OUR TOP 3 REASONS:

- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design
- Responsibility right from the start
- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international company

After an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have. Apply now with your complete application documents, your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.
WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION.

-------------------

Wir sind schnell. Wir sind farbenfroh. Wir sind laut und leise. Wir lieben, was wir tun, und leisten täglich einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden. description: Per conto di una realtà tecnologica di grandi dimensioni, operante in un contesto internazionale, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Senior Cyber Security Engineer da inserire all'interno di un team Cyber Security strutturato. La risorsa entrerà a far parte di una funzione tecnica che opera trasversalmente a supporto delle diverse aree IT, Software e Business del Gruppo, contribuendo alla progettazione, evoluzione e miglioramento dei servizi e dei controlli di Cyber Security. Cerchiamo un professionista con una buona seniority tecnica e una visione trasversale della sicurezza, capace di andare oltre la gestione operativa degli incidenti e contribuire all'evoluzione dell'ecosistema Cyber aziendale. Principali responsabilità La persona sarà coinvolta in attività quali: supporto a nuovi progetti IT e Software secondo principi di Security by Design, attraverso security review e definizione dei requisiti di sicurezza; definizione ed evoluzione dei controlli di Cloud Security, principalmente in ambienti Microsoft Azure e AWS; presidio delle tematiche di Identity Security, con particolare riferimento a Microsoft Entra ID e Active Directory; valutazione e scouting di nuove tecnologie e servizi messi a disposizione dai principali cloud e security provider; evoluzione dei servizi di Cyber Security Monitoring, collaborando con il SOC esterno e contribuendo al tuning delle piattaforme SIEM e dei relativi controlli di detection; attività di Vulnerability Management su componenti infrastrutturali e applicative; evoluzione dei presidi di sicurezza relativi a Firewall, WAF, endpoint, infrastrutture e ambienti Cloud; supporto ad attività di Incident Response e miglioramento continuo dei relativi processi e controlli; partecipazione alla definizione di iniziative di Purple Teaming, finalizzate all'identificazione delle aree di miglioramento della postura difensiva; confronto con Software Architect, Service Manager, team IT e Business per integrare i requisiti Cyber all'interno di nuovi servizi e applicazioni; supporto, quando necessario, nel confronto con clienti enterprise sui presidi di sicurezza adottati nei servizi erogati. Profilo ricercato Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza in ambito Cyber Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security o Security Architecture, maturata in contesti aziendali strutturati o all'interno di società di consulenza tecnologica. Non è necessario aver maturato esperienza approfondita in tutte le aree indicate. Sarà particolarmente interessante una solida competenza in una o più delle seguenti: Cloud Security in ambienti Azure e/o AWS; Identity & Access Security, Entra ID / Active Directory; Security Engineering e definizione di security controls; Cyber Security Monitoring e tecnologie SIEM/XDR; Vulnerability Management; Infrastructure & Network Security; Application Security / Security by Design. Saranno considerate un plus esperienze in ambito Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Security, Incident Response, Purple Teaming e attività di security assessment. È richiesta una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Offerta RAL indicativa: €50.000 - €60.000 + MBO, valutabile in funzione dell'esperienza; inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato; modalità di lavoro ibrida con 2 giorni alla settimana in presenza a Bologna; #LI-AM2

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

title: Kiemsargis
description:
1.    Palaikyti švarą ir tvarką mokyklos teritorijoje.
2.    Kasdien nušluoti takelius, šaligatvius, iškaupti žolę takeliuose ir žaidimų aikštelėse, surinkti šiukšles (1–2 val. prieš ateinant vaikams).
3.    Vasaros, rudens ir pavasario laikotarpiu prižiūrėti bei laistyti gėlynus, pjauti žolę.
4.    Prižiūrėti ir tinkamai eksploatuoti naudojamą techniką: žoliapjovę, žoliapjovės traktorių, trimerius (valyti, tikrinti techninę būklę, atlikti smulkų remontą, laiku informuoti apie gedimus).
5.    Užtikrinti tinkamą technikos saugojimą, laikymą ir priežiūrą ne darbo metu.
6.    Vykdyti kuro sunaudojimo apskaitą, racionaliai naudoti kurą ir kitas eksploatacines medžiagas.
7.    Žiemą nukasti sniegą nuo takelių, šaligatvių, žaidimų aikštelių, įėjimų į pastatą, barstyti takelius smėliu.
8.    Kasdien apžiūrėti inventorių; esant gedimams – remontuoti savo jėgomis arba informuoti pavaduotoją ūkio reikalams.
9.    Perdažyti lauko įrenginius, atlikti smulkų jų remontą.
Kiemsargio atsakomybė: už mokyklos teritorijos priežiūrą ir tvarką; už sanitarinių higieninių reikalavimų vykdymą; už saugos darbe ir priešgaisrinės saugos reikalavimų laikymąsi; Už patikėtos technikos, įrankių ir inventoriaus saugumą, tinkamą naudojimą bei priežiūrą; už kuro ir eksploatacinių medžiagų racionalų naudojimą; už aukščiau išvardintų pareigų vykdymą.
Kiemsargis privalo: vykdyti mokyklos direktoriaus, pavaduotojo ūkiui arba įgaliotų asmenų su darbu susijusius nurodymus. Mokėti saugiai dirbti ir netrukdyti saugiai dirbti kitiems. Laiku tikrintis sveikatą. Laikytis įstaigos vidaus tvarkos taisyklių, darbe nevartoti alkoholinių gėrimų bei narkotinių medžiagų. Laikytis įrenginių naudojimo instrukcijų reikalavimų, asmens higienos reikalavimų.

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

perkame juodųjų ir spalvotųjų metalų laužą Lietuvoje, parduodame perdirbėjams ir eksportui per Klaipėdą. Ieškome vadybininko, kuris veda sandorį nuo tiekėjo iki pirkėjo ir atsako už jo maržą.
Uždarbis – bazinė dalis ir komisiniai nuo sandorio maržos.

Pirkimo pusė.

Tiekėjų paieška: metalo apdirbimo ir gamybos įmonės, statybos ir demontavimo objektai, laivų
remontas, transporto aikštelės, savivaldybių įmonės.
Objektų apžiūra vietoje: kiek medžiagos, kokios rūšies ir būklės, ar ją reikės pjaustyti, kaip bus
kraunama.
Kainos pasiūlymas pagal medžiagos rūšį ir tos dienos kainoraštį.
Susitarimas dėl konteinerio ar mašinos pastatymo, pakrovimo laiko ir svėrimo vietos.
Atskaitymų už priemaišas derinimas su tiekėju iki pakrovimo.
Pardavimo pusė
Pirkėjų paieška ir derybos Lietuvoje, Baltijos šalyse ir eksporto rinkose.
Partijos komplektavimas iš kelių tiekėjų iki vieno kokybės lygio.
Kainos derinimas pagal tarptautinius indeksus.
Pasiūlymų teikimas su aiškiu galiojimo terminu.
Sandorio vedimas
Eksporto ir atliekų vežimo dokumentai: Annex VII per DIWASS, GPAIS lydraščiai, sąskaitos,
svėrimo pažymos, CMR, eksporto deklaracijos.
Konteinerių užsakymas ir pakrovimo koordinavimas su aikštele bei ekspedicija.
Svorio ir kokybės pretenzijų po iškrovimo sprendimas.
Apmokėjimo sekimas iki pinigų gavimo.
Regionas
Pasiteisinus pirmiems rezultatams – naujo regiono atidarymas ir jo tiekėjų tinklo formavimas.

title: Senior Relationship Manager - AIF Depositary (m/f)
description:
Senior Relationship Manager - AIF Depositary (M/F)
Luxembourg
req1167

Apply Now

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

Your Key Objectives:

You will be responsible for implementing the Bank's commercial strategy and risk policy within the Alternative Funds segment, both in Luxembourg and abroad. You will manage and develop profitable client relationships, promote the Institutional Banking Value Proposition, and contribute to the growth of the Alternative Investment Funds business.

Your next challenge:

• Manage and develop a portfolio of clients in the Custodian Banking/Depositary segment and foster long-term relationships through regular client interactions.
• Act as the primary point of contact for clients within BIL, ensuring effective coordination between clients and all relevant internal stakeholders.
• Achieve assigned objectives in terms of revenue, costs, deposit collection and credit production, while actively contributing to the performance of the Alternative Investment Funds (AIF) team and Institutional Banking (IB).
• Promote the IB Value Proposition by developing a thorough understanding of clients' situations and proposing solutions that address their current and future needs.
• Maintain a strong knowledge of BIL's products and services, particularly those dedicated to AIF clients.
• Leverage the expertise available across IB to deliver comprehensive client solutions, drive cross-selling initiatives and identify business growth opportunities in collaboration with the Business Developers.
• Ensure compliance with all applicable policies, procedures and regulatory requirements, including KYC and AML obligations.
• Oversee the operational follow-up of client requests and instructions, working closely with the Business Office and Compliance teams to ensure service quality and efficiency.
• Contribute to knowledge sharing and training initiatives within Institutional Banking by supporting colleagues and continuously developing specialized expertise.
• Act as an ambassador of the BIL Group through participation in conferences, presentations, training sessions and industry events, while maintaining a strong professional network.
• Contribute to the development and enhancement of products and services for AIF clients through an innovative and client-focused approach.

Your skills:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Audit, Law, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• Minimum 5 to 7 years of experience in the banking, fund industry and/or depositary environment.
• Excellent understanding of the AIFMD framework and the related legal and regulatory environment.
• In-depth knowledge of alternative asset classes, including Private Equity, Private Debt, Real Estate and Infrastructure.
• Extensive understanding of banking activities, organisational structures, operational risk management processes and control frameworks.
• Solid knowledge of banking products and services, including cash and treasury management, securities services, financing and capital markets solutions.
• Proven experience in operational risk assessment, process enhancement and monitoring activities.
• Good understanding of the key drivers and market dynamics of the European fund industry.
• Strong analytical, strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent presentation, communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal.
• Team player with an entrepreneurial mindset and a collaborative approach.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of additional languages is considered an asset.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

title: Expert en Communications Unifiées (m/f)
description:
Expert en Communications Unifiées (H/F) – CDI temps complet

Vous souhaitez rejoindre une société dynamique, leader sur son marché et disposant d'un large portefeuille de solutions. Telkea Group est à la recherche d'un Expert en Communications Unifiées

Missions

Vous intégrerez l'équipe UC Alcatel & NetPBX de Telkea ICT en tant qu'Expert en Communications Unifiées, avec une spécialisation sur les environnements Alcatel- Lucent Enterprise.

Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des solutions : analyse des besoins, conception, installation, configuration, mise en production, maintenance, support et amélioration continue.

Vous serez également amené à évoluer progressivement vers les technologies de notification serveur (Mobicall), d'appel malade et de communication dans les environnements de soins, ou à mettre directement à profit une expérience existante dans ces domaines.

Dans le cadre de vos missions, vous interviendrez sur les plateformes de Telkea ICT ainsi que chez nos clients au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région. Vous serez un interlocuteur technique privilégié et contribuerez à garantir la qualité des installations, la continuité de service et la satisfaction de nos clients.

Dans le cadre de vos activités, vous serez notamment amené à ;

• Réaliser les nouvelles installations et mises en service de solutions Alcatel OXE/Rainbow ;
• Installer, configurer et maintenir les systèmes de téléphonie et de communications unifiées ;
• Assurer le support technique de niveau 2 et 3 ;
• Traiter quotidiennement les tickets MACD — Move, Add, Change, Delete — ainsi que les incidents et pannes ;
• Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes liés à la téléphonie, aux réseaux, à la signalisation SIP et aux flux audio ;
• Assurer l'installation, la configuration et le support des solutions de notification serveur Mobicall et d'appel malade ;
• Participer à l'intégration des solutions d'appel malade avec les environnements téléphoniques et les systèmes clients ;
• Évoluer vers une expertise complète des solutions de notification serveur, d'appel malade et de communication destinées aux établissements de soins ;
• Assurer la maintenance préventive et corrective des infrastructures installées ;
• Participer aux migrations, montées de version et évolutions techniques des plateformes ;
• Assurer la permanence technique selon un système de roulement ;
• Prendre en charge le suivi administratif et technique des projets ;
• Mettre à jour la base de données et la documentation des clients ;
• Rédiger les rapports d'intervention, dossiers techniques, procédures et documents d'exploitation ;
• Produire et maintenir les documentations de configuration et les dossiers « as-built » ;
• Assurer une communication technique claire et professionnelle avec les clients ;
• Collaborer avec les fournisseurs, les équipes internes et les autres intervenants des projets ;
• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des méthodes, procédures et outils internes ;
• Développer régulièrement vos compétences techniques ;
• Respecter les exigences de qualité, de confidentialité et de service propres à la clientèle de Telkea ICT.

Profil recherché

Vous disposez d'une expérience d'au moins 5 ans dans un rôle similaire, dans le domaine des télécommunications, des communications unifiées, des réseaux ou des systèmes d'appel malade.

Vous avez une large culture technique et êtes capable d'intervenir sur des solutions dans leur ensemble, depuis l'installation et la configuration jusqu'au dépannage avancé et au support client.

Une expérience ou des connaissances dans les domaines suivants sont particulièrement appréciées:

• Solutions de téléphonie Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise ;
• Plateformes Alcatel OmniPCX Enterprise et/ou OXO ;
• Téléphonie IP, SIP, VoIP et trunks opérateurs ;
• Réseaux IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, routage et QoS ;
• Solutions de notification serveur Solutions Mobicall ou technologies équivalentes ;
• Solutions d'appel malade et environnements hospitaliers ou résidentiels ;
• Intégration entre systèmes de téléphonie, DECT, systèmes de recherche de personnes et dispositifs d'alerte ;
• Supervision, ticketing et outils de diagnostic réseau.

Compétences:

• Expertise des environnements de téléphonie (la connaissance d'Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise OXE et Rainbow constitue un atout) ;
• Bonne maîtrise de la téléphonie IP et du protocole SIP ;
• Solides bases en réseaux TCP/IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, routage et QoS ;
• Solides bases systèmes Windows, Linux et virtualisation ;
• Capacité à analyser des traces et captures réseau, notamment à l'aide de Wireshark ;
• Expérience en installation, configuration et dépannage de systèmes complexes ;
• La connaissance des environnements DECT et des solutions de mobilité Rainbow constitue un atout ;
• La connaissance des solutions de notification serveur Mobicall et d'appel malade constitue un atout ;
• Capacité à comprendre les flux d'alerte, de notification, d'acquittement et d'escalade ;
• Aptitude à rédiger des documents techniques clairs et structurés ;
• Sensibilité aux aspects de sécurité, de disponibilité et de continuité de service ;
• La connaissance d'outils de supervision et de gestion des tickets est appréciée.

Langues

• Maîtrise du français requise, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
• Bon niveau d'anglais requis (documentation et échanges techniques).
• La maîtrise du luxembourgeois est un atout.

Ce que nous proposons

• Un CDI à temps complet.
• Un package attractif.
• Un cycle continu de formation et la possibilité d'évoluer dans l'entreprise.
• Une équipe dynamique et soudée créant un cadre de travail très agréable.
• Une société où l'employé et le client sont au cœur de toutes les attentions.
• Un groupe leader dont le siège au Luxembourg facilite l'adéquation entre organisation, solutions et attente du marché.

A propos de Telkea Group

Fondé en 1929 au Luxembourg, Telkea Group compte actuellement plus de 150 collaborateurs dans de multiples domaines d'activités et actifs dans les secteurs de la finance (agrément PSF), la santé, l'hôtellerie, l'industrie, les services, le secteur public et
les Institutions européennes.

Telkea Group (Telkea ICT, Telkea Security, Telkea Telecom et Telkea Soft) fournit des solutions d'intégration ICT, de services Cloud, de sécurité des bâtiments, d'intégration audiovisuelle et d'opérateur téléphonique au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région ainsi qu'une large palette de solutions IT et un service d'éditeur d'applications métiers.

Nous accompagnons les administrations, les grandes entreprises et les PME avec la même vision claire : se poser en partenaire fiable, flexible et innovant.

Vous possédez les qualités requises ci-dessus ? Veuillez s'il vous plaît envoyer votre lettre de motivation et votre curriculum vitae (en français ou en anglais) à l'adresse : jobs@telkea.com en indiquant « Candidature au poste d'Expert en Communications Unifiées (H/F) ».

Votre candidature sera traitée en toute confidentialité.

title: Lower School Teaching Assistant (Gr2 Classrooms) 6-months contract (m/f)
description:
Lower School Teaching Assistant (Gr2 Classrooms) 6-months contract

We're delighted that you're considering joining our learning community at ISL. As you consider this opportunity, we kindly ask that you apply only if you can join us on the stated start date and will be fully free from any existing contractual or notice-period obligations by that time. We appreciate your understanding.

The role?
At ISL, we believe our young learners are capable, curious and full of ideas. They learn through relationships, play, inquiry and meaningful exploration of the world around them. We are seeking a Lower School Classroom Teaching Assistant to assist our Grade 2 teachers (students ages 7-8) in creating caring, inclusive environments where every student feels a sense of belonging, develops agency and independence, and experiences the joy of learning.

Working in partnership with the classroom teacher and wider Lower School team, the Teaching Assistant is an important resource for students and parents.

What will you do?

Working alongside the Grade 2 classroom teachers, you will:

• help create a caring and inquiry-rich learning environment;
• support individuals and small groups during student-initiated and teacher-directed learning;
• encourage curiosity, communication, collaboration, creativity and problem-solving;
• observe and document students' learning and emerging needs;
• prepare materials and learning spaces that invite exploration;
• support arrival, dismissal, transitions, specialist lessons, lunch, playground and other daily routines;
• help children develop positive relationships, independence and a sense of responsibility; and
• supervise and accompany students during activities, field trips and other experiences beyond the classroom.

What skills do you bring?

We are interested in what you can do, how you work with others and your potential to learn and grow. Your skills may have been developed through education, employment, volunteering, or community activities.

You will be able to demonstrate your ability to:

• Build trusting relationships with young students, helping them feel safe, known and valued.
• Support learning through inquiry, using conversation, thoughtful questions and exploration to extend students' thinking.
• Notice and respond to learners, observing students and collaborating with the teachers to document learning and development.
• Foster agency and independence, knowing when to support, when to question and when to give students space to try for themselves.
• Support multilingual learners and communicate clearly and sensitively with students developing English as an additional language.
• Create inclusive environments that value different languages, cultures, experiences and ways of learning.
• Collaborate effectively with teachers and colleagues and build positive, professional relationships with
• families.
• Support students' wellbeing, relationships, routines, transitions and self-management in developmentally appropriate ways.
• Adapt and take initiative in the dynamic environment of a classroom.
• Reflect and grow, welcoming feedback and taking responsibility for your own professional learning.

Who you are?

You genuinely enjoy being with young students and see them as capable learners. You are patient, curious, dependable and proactive. You understand that learning happens throughout the day—from a student's question to developing independence during routines or navigating a disagreement with a friend. You communicate thoughtfully, value different perspectives and cultures, and know that excellent support sometimes means stepping forward and sometimes stepping back.
Above all, you bring care, curiosity, collaboration and a commitment to helping every student participate, learn and belong.
Our commitment to students
Through this role, you will support ISL's Strategic Plan by helping deliver a Lower School programme that meets high creative and academic standards and enables students to be active, engaged and successful learners.
ISL is committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expects you to share this commitment. You will be expected to maintain appropriate professional boundaries, demonstrate sound judgement and follow ISL's child protection, health, safety and security policies and procedures.
We are keen to attract applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly those whose nationality, identity, gender or race is currently under-represented in international education.
Profile: (training, experience, skills and aptitudes necessary to do the job)

Required:

• A minimum of a secondary school diploma or equivalent.
• Fluency in English, with strong spoken and written communication.
• Successful experience working with children, ideally ages 7-8;
• Strong interpersonal, communication and collaboration skills;
• Confidence with digital technology relevant to the role.
• The ability to work positively and responsibly with children and adults.

Valued experience includes:

We value experience working with young students in educational settings, childcare, after-school programmes or other environments where children learn and develop together. Particularly relevant experience includes supporting play- or inquiry-based learning, multilingual learners, children's social-emotional development and
independence, and working collaboratively with colleagues and families in culturally diverse communities. Experience in an IB PYP or another child-centred, inquiry-based setting is an advantage, but is not essential.
We recognise that strong candidates bring different experiences and pathways. We encourage you to apply if you believe your skills, approach and experience equip you to succeed in this role, even if you do not meet every preferred criterion.

Among main responsibilities:

General:

• Assist in creating a caring, positive learning environment as directed by the classroom teacher;
• Promote mutual respect and understanding among all members of the group;
• Establish and maintain positive relationships with students, parents, colleagues and leadership;
• Assist in maintaining expectations of student behaviour in and out of the classroom to create a well-functioning and consistent learning atmosphere in school;
• Comply with School policies and procedures relating to child protection, health, safety, welfare, security, confidentiality and data protection, reporting any concerns to the appropriate person;
• Collaborate with the classroom teacher to gather and document evidence of student learning;
• Maintain familiarity and understanding of the ISL curriculum and assist in its delivery as directed by the classroom teacher and appropriate for level of qualification;
• Support the Lower School culture of thinking;
• Be familiar with all school rules and conscientiously assist in enforcing them;
Within the Classroom:
• Assist with classroom related tasks (including preparation, set-up and clearing up of materials for learning activities and supervision thereof) as directed by the classroom teacher;
• Assist the teacher at the start and end of the day welcoming and dismissing students (including taking attendance and lunch count as well as supervising students during transitions);
• Assist with large group activities and work with smaller groups on teacher-directed tasks;
Outside of the Classroom:
• Supervise and escort students as they go to and from specialist lessons;
• Perform supervisory duties within other areas of the school (cafeteria, playgrounds, etc) as directed;
• Assist a student in the event of sickness or accident;
• Accompany the classroom teacher and students on field trips and other excursions outside school;
Additional:
• When absent, leave information concerning daily tasks for substitute;
• Handle personal problems and grievances in a professional way as outline [...]

title: Research Scientist in Economics of Sustainability (m/f)
description:
Description:


Language: English (UK)
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Luxembourg Centre for Socio-Environmental Systems
Job Number: UOL08508
Contract Type: Permanent
Expected Start Date: 01/11/2026

Job Level: level 1
Functions: Researcher
Role Type: Cluster
Expertise: Researcher / Postdoctorant
Job (internal): Research scientist


Your role:

The successful candidate will establish internationally visible research at the interface of economics, sustainability science and global environmental change, developing new quantitative approaches to understand and steer transformations across food, land, water and natural-resource systems.
The candidate's research will combine economic theory, fine-scale spatial data, empirical evidence and computational modelling to explain trade-offs, synergies and spillovers that remain hidden in single-scale analyses. Relevant research may address at least three of the following fields: agricultural production, labor markets, natural-resource scarcity, food security, climate change, technological change, impacts of demographic transition, social cohesion, resilience of supply chains, environmental policy, and the distributional consequences of sustainability transformations.
A key ambition is to move beyond diagnosing unsustainable trajectories towards designing effective and equitable transformation pathways, exploring how policy, innovation and global interconnectedness can reconcile environmental sustainability with food security, livelihoods and economic development.


Your profile:

The successful candidate holds a strong academic background in economics, agricultural or environmental economics, together with an internationally recognized research record. They have demonstrated expertise in economic theory and quantitative modelling, complemented by experience with spatially explicit data, empirical estimation, computational methods or other approaches capable of linking processes across scales.
Additionally, they can translate theoretical concepts into transparent, empirically grounded models and integrate economic analysis with insights and data from other disciplines. Experience in interdisciplinary research on food, land, water, climate, natural resources or related sustainability challenges can be proven by documented participation within interdisciplinary networks and projects.
The successful candidate is an intellectually independent researcher with the ambition to build a collaborative, interdisciplinary research team, attract competitive research funding, develop innovative methodological approaches and contribute to policy-relevant sustainability science. A commitment to open, reproducible research, excellent communication across disciplinary boundaries, and the ability to engage effectively with policy and practice are essential.


The ideal candidate will have:

• A PhD in a relevant field and a minimum of 4 years Postdoc experience demonstrating ability to independently develop a research agenda
• A strong capability to think out of the box and shape their research around the challenges posed by interdisciplinary questions
• A strong record of research excellence, evidenced by impactful publications and success in securing external research funding
• Willingness to contribute to teaching programmes at the undergraduate and graduate levels in areas related to environmental change and socio-environmental systems


Language requirements:

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired for this position must have an excellent command of English. The University encourages its staff to learn additional languages and provides access to language courses to this end.


We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance


How to apply:

Applications should contain:

• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable


All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception.


General Information:

• Reference: UOL08508 (to be mentioned in all correspondence)
• Publication date: -
• Contract Type: Permanent
• Working Hours:  
• Location: Belval Campus
• Planned starting date: 01/11/2026


Gender equality:

In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, diversity and a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of everybody is respected. The University is committed to achieving gender parity among its academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

title: Senior Consultant FAAS Valuation (Real Estate) (m/f)
description:
Senior Consultant FAAS Valuation (Real Estate)

Location:  Luxembourg
Other locations:  Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive

Job description

Requisition ID:  1718972

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

EY is a global professional services organization providing advisory, assurance, tax, and transaction advisory services. We are committed to building a better working world for our people, our clients, and our communities. We are united by our shared values and dedication to delivering exceptional client service.

At EY, we support you in achieving your unique potential—both personally and professionally. While we encourage you to take personal responsibility for your career, we support your professional development in every way we can. You will enjoy the flexibility to devote time to what matters to you, in both your business and personal lives. At EY, you can be who you are and express your point of view, energy, and enthusiasm, wherever you are in the world. It's how you make a difference.

Your key responsibilities

As a Senior Consultant – FAAS Valuation (Real Estate), you will perform and carry out valuation analyses and reviews of real estate assets and portfolios in the context of financial reporting and assurance engagements.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Performing valuation analyses and review of real estate assets, assessing the reasonableness of valuations and financial models
• Developing independent valuation perspectives and benchmarking analyses based on market data and appropriate methodologies
• Leading, coordinating, and developing a team of Assistants, ensuring effective execution of engagements
• Building and maintaining productive working relationships with client personnel and assessing client satisfaction
• Applying a strong understanding of valuation concepts to real-world real estate scenarios
• Coordinating fieldwork and collaborating with audit teams and other departments to ensure smooth delivery of engagements
• Contributing to the delivery of valuation processes, solutions, and projects by applying judgement and selecting appropriate methodologies
• Taking responsibility for meeting personal and team performance targets and supporting junior team members
• Ensuring high-quality deliverables, compliance with risk management requirements, and adherence to EY standards
• Identifying risks and opportunities, enhancing client trust, and contributing to business development and team growth

Skills and attributes for success

Der Tätigkeitsschwerpunkt liegt im Remote-Arbeiten mit regelmäßigen Projekteinsätzen in Luxemburg.

So tragen Sie zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg bei

- Fehleranalyse: Sie leiten komplexe Ursachenanalysen mit Methoden wie 8D, FTA und Ishikawa und begleiten die Bearbeitung kritischer Produktprobleme
- Qualitätsverbesserung: Sie erkennen wiederkehrende Fehler- und Qualitätstrends und leiten nachhaltige Korrektur- und Präventionsmaßnahmen ab
- Produktqualität: Sie unterstützen Entwicklungsteams bei der Verbesserung von Produktsicherheit, Entwicklungsqualität und Prozesskonformität
- Datenanalyse: Sie analysieren Qualitäts- und Fehlerdaten, identifizieren systemische Schwachstellen und schaffen die Grundlage für gezielte Optimierungen
- Problemlösung: Sie koordinieren funktionsübergreifende Teams bei der Bearbeitung interner sowie kundenseitiger Qualitätsprobleme und unterstützen die Priorisierung kritischer Fehler
- Kundenkommunikation: Sie begleiten die technische Abstimmung mit Kunden bei kritischen Produktproblemen und den daraus resultierenden Korrekturmaßnahmen
- Methodenkompetenz: Sie vermitteln Best Practices der strukturierten Problemlösung und unterstützen die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Entwicklungs- und Qualitätsmethoden

Das bringen Sie mit

- Qualifikation: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Elektronik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung
- Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Automotive, Automobilelektronik, E-Mobilität oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Umfeld sowie erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Steuerung von Projekten oder Teams
- ECU-Entwicklung: Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung elektronischer Steuergeräte, idealerweise im Bereich Hochvolt-Inverter
- Qualitätsmethoden: Praxiserfahrung mit strukturierten Problemlösungsmethoden wie 8D, FTA und Ishikawa sowie ausgeprägtes prozessorientiertes Denken
- Normen: Kenntnisse in Systems Engineering sowie relevanten Automotive-Standards wie ISO 26262 und Automotive SPICE
- Tools: Erfahrung mit Projekt-, Anforderungs- und Ticketmanagementsystemen wie Microsoft Project, Polarion, DOORS, JIRA oder IBM Rational RTC
- Kommunikation: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, interkulturelle Kompetenz sowie Bereitschaft, rund 30 % der Tätigkeit vor Ort in Luxemburg zu arbeiten

Was wir bieten

- Attraktive Konditionen: Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit einer Vergütung, die Ihrer Qualifikation und Erfahrung entspricht
- Flexible Arbeitsweise: Verbinden Sie überwiegend mobiles Arbeiten mit gezielten Projekteinsätzen vor Ort in Luxemburg
- Dynamisches Team: Werden Sie Teil eines internationalen Entwicklungsumfelds, das technische Verantwortung und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit fördert

title: Executive Assistant & Business Management Support - CEO Office (m/f)
description:
Description:


Executive Assistant


Pour l'un de nos clients, acteur bancaire de premier plan au Luxembourg, nous recherchons un(e) Executive Assistant & Business Management Support pour rejoindre l'environnement direct du CEO et de son Executive Office.


A PROPOS DU POSTE

Vous avez déjà acquis une première expérience solide dans un environnement exigeant, idéalement au sein d'un Big4, d'un cabinet de conseil, d'un cabinet d'avocats ou du secteur financier, et vous souhaitez aujourd'hui vous rapprocher du cœur des décisions d'une organisation ?

Cette opportunité va au-delà d'un poste classique d'Executive Assistant.

Aux côtés du CEO et de son environnement exécutif, vous combinez support de haut niveau, coordination, préparation de supports et suivi de sujets stratégiques et opérationnels.

Votre rôle : permettre au CEO d'être organisé, préparé et concentré sur ses priorités, tout en assurant un suivi rigoureux des informations, demandes et actions qui gravitent autour de l'Executive Office.

Il s'agit d'une fonction particulièrement intéressante pour un profil ayant environ 5 années d'expérience, souhaitant continuer à apprendre, gagner en exposition et évoluer progressivement vers des responsabilités plus larges de Business Management / Executive Office.


VOTRE RÔLE ET RESPONSABILITES:
Executive Support & organisation

Vous assurez un support quotidien fluide et structuré auprès du CEO et de son environnement exécutif :

    gestion proactive d'un agenda complexe et mouvant ;
    organisation et coordination des réunions internes et externes ;
    préparation des rendez-vous, agendas et documents nécessaires ;
    anticipation des échéances et identification des priorités ;
    coordination des déplacements professionnels et de leur logistique ;
    gestion des notes de frais, factures et autres sujets administratifs associés.

Vous ne vous contentez pas d'organiser : vous anticipez, identifiez les conflits de priorité et proposez des solutions.
Business Management & coordination

Une partie importante de votre rôle consiste à faciliter le fonctionnement de l'Executive Office.

À ce titre, vous :

    assurez le suivi des actions et décisions prises lors des réunions ;
    sollicitez les différentes parties prenantes afin d'obtenir les informations attendues ;
    consolidez des informations provenant de plusieurs interlocuteurs ;
    structurez ces éléments afin de les rendre immédiatement exploitables par le CEO ;
    maintenez des trackers et outils de suivi permettant de donner de la visibilité sur l'avancement des différents sujets ;
    contribuez à la coordination de projets et initiatives transverses ;
    identifiez les échéances ou sujets nécessitant une attention particulière et les faites remonter de manière proactive.

Votre capacité à comprendre rapidement un sujet, structurer l'information et assurer le suivi jusqu'à sa finalisation fera réellement la différence.
Executive Communication & préparation de supports

Vous contribuez directement à la qualité des informations et documents utilisés au niveau exécutif :

    préparation et mise en forme de présentations PowerPoint ;
    préparation de briefings, notes de synthèse et meeting packs ;
    consolidation de données et préparation de reportings simples sous Excel ;
    rédaction, relecture et adaptation de communications en français et en anglais ;
    préparation et organisation de documents destinés à des réunions de management ou de gouvernance.

Vous savez transformer une quantité importante d'informations en un support clair, synthétique et orienté décision.
Coordination & stakeholder management

Positionné(e) au cœur de l'organisation, vous êtes en interaction avec de nombreux interlocuteurs internes et externes.

Vous assurez une communication fluide et professionnelle, relancez lorsque nécessaire et savez adapter votre approche à des interlocuteurs de niveaux de séniorité différents.

La confidentialité, la diplomatie et la qualité de votre communication sont essentielles dans cette fonction.


Vous avez idéalement :

    un Bachelor ou Master en gestion, économie, management ou formation équivalente ;
    environ 5 années d'expérience professionnelle dans une fonction d'Executive Assistant, Business Support, PMO, Executive Office ou une fonction comparable ;
    une expérience acquise dans un Big4 ou un environnement de conseil/professional services exigeant, fortement appréciée ;
    l'habitude de travailler directement avec des Partners, Managing Directors, membres de direction ou autres senior executives ;
    une excellente maîtrise de PowerPoint, avec la capacité de produire des présentations professionnelles et structurées ;
    une bonne maîtrise d'Excel et des outils de suivi/reporting ;
    d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse ;
    une parfaite maîtrise professionnelle du français et de l'anglais ; le luxembourgeois constitue un atout.

Au-delà de votre expérience, nous recherchons surtout une personnalité.

Vous êtes structuré(e), fiable et extrêmement organisé(e), mais également curieux(se) et capable de comprendre ce qui se joue derrière une demande.

Vous savez travailler dans un environnement où les priorités peuvent changer rapidement, sans perdre en qualité ni en précision.

Vous êtes à l'aise avec des interlocuteurs seniors tout en conservant une posture professionnelle et naturelle.

Enfin, vous recherchez un poste dans lequel vous pourrez apprendre, prendre progressivement davantage de responsabilités et développer une compréhension transverse du fonctionnement d'une banque et de son Executive Management.

description:
SD-26153 R&T ENGINEER - VR USER INTERFACE DEVELOPER

Fixed term contract | Belval | 2.5 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

We are looking for a skilled and hands-on VR User Interface Developer to join a short-term research and development project. The successful candidate will design and implement an immersive user interface running on a VR headset and connect it to a robot digital twin. The interface will enable users to visualise the robot, access relevant operational information, and interact with the digital-twin environment in an intuitive and reliable way. The role combines virtual-reality development, user-interface engineering, 3D interaction design, and integration with robotics or simulation software.

Key tasks:

·       Designing and developing an immersive user interface for a VR headset.
·      Implementing intuitive 3D interactions, menus, dashboards, status indicators, controls, and notifications.
·      Integrating the VR interface with a robot digital twin and its underlying simulation or robotics platform.
·       Visualising relevant robot and system information, such as robot position, operating mode, sensor data, alerts, and task progress.
·       Supporting user interaction with the robot digital twin, including monitoring, exploration, and, where applicable, control functionalities.
·       Developing the application using a suitable real-time 3D engine, such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
·       Testing and optimising the interface on the target VR headset, with particular attention to usability, reliability, and performance.
·       Collaborating with researchers, robotics engineers, software developers, and user-experience specialists.
·       Maintaining the source code and preparing technical documentation covering the architecture, installation, configuration, and integration procedures.
·       Delivering a functional and demonstrable prototype within the three-month assignment.

Education

·          University degree or equivalent professional experience in computer science, software engineering, game development, robotics, human-computer interaction, or a related field.
·          Knowledge of software development, 3D visualisation, virtual reality, and user-interface design.

Language skills

•               Fluency in English (and French), both oral and written. Other relevant languages are an asset.

Your LIST benefits

·          Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society

·          Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
·          Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
·          Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
·          Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
·          32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
·          Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online

Your application must include:

·          A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
·          A CV with contact details
Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions

We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on national origin, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.
Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.
As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. Further checks and restrictions might apply to candidates in compliance with export controls requirements
For the purposes of the position and in accordance with applicable legislation, the successful candidate may be requested to provide a recent criminal record certificate.

This position offers a gross monthly salary between €5043 and €6586, paid over 13 months (€65.559–€85.618 annually) based on full time employment. The final salary offer within this range will be determined based on the candidate's overall profile, qualifications and professional experience. For part time employment, the salary is adjusted pro rata.

Head of Vendor Management & Outsourcing (M/F)

Luxembourg | req1172

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

The Head of Vendor Management and Outsourcing is responsible for defining and executing the Bank's vendor strategy framework and leading end-to-end commercial, contractual, and regulatory vendor management activities. The role acts as the Finance-led control tower across the vendor lifecycle, ensuring financial discipline, contractual control, and regulatory compliance while optimizing vendor value and supporting outsourcing decisions.

Your next challenge:

• Define and maintain vendor segmentation (strategic / critical / commodity) and steer the vendor portfolio.
• Act as the Outsourcing Activity Manager and represent the Bank towards the Regulator on outsourcing.
• Support outsourcing and make-or-buy decisions and monitor vendor concentration and exposure.
• Own budgeting, forecasting, cost control, benchmarking and value realization for vendor spend.
• Establish and maintain comprehensive reportings, leveraging data analytics to drive decision-making, monitor performance, and provide actionable insights.
• Lead contract negotiation, lifecycle management, renewal and commercial governance.
• Act as primary commercial face to vendor and manage relationships with strategic vendors and group entities.
• Ensure compliance with DORA, EBA and CSSF requirements and maintain outsourcing register.
• Establish end-to-end vendor lifecycle governance and coordinate with CIO, Procurement, Legal and Risk.
• Lead change management initiatives related to vendor and outsourcing processes, and educate internal stakeholders on best practices, regulatory requirements, and risk awareness.
• Foster a culture of continuous learning, provide mentoring and coaching to team members, and promote knowledge sharing and best practices within the team.
• Maintain strong first line operational risk controls by overseeing vendor, facility and infrastructure processes, ensuring compliance with internal policies and escalating operational or safety risks.

Your skills:

• Master's degree in Business, Finance or Engineering.
• Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in vendor management, procurement or outsourcing in regulated environment.
• Knowledge of DORA, EBA Outsourcing Guidelines and CSSF frameworks.
• Strong negotiation and financial management capabilities.
• Strong understanding of IT vendor management, including vendor selection, contract management, performance monitoring, and relationship management.
• Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to build, develop, and motivate high-performing teams.
• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities, with a data-driven approach to strategy development.
• Demonstrated track record of leading strategic initiatives, business transformation programs, and organizational change at a senior level.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.
