How will you contribute?
Get ready to dive into the captivating realm of ferroelectrics, where surprises at the nanoscale await discovery! We are thrilled to announce a unique opportunity for a curious and skilled Postdoctoral Researcher to join our dynamic team.
Ferroelectrics continue to mesmerize at the nanoscale. By inducing electrostatic or mechanic frustration on them, we can unlock a rich tapestry of dipole structures, including skyrmions and vortex lattices. Such polar textures are a hot research topic and offer a dual promise. First, their origin and behaviour pose intriguing questions begging for answers. Second, they hold great potential for groundbreaking applications, from outstanding voltage amplifications to shaping the future of 6G technologies.
In the realm of ferroelectric ultrathin films, we are facing new challenges. Applying an electric bias transforms the dipole landscape, giving rise to confined nanoregions (bubbles) with a polarization opposite to their embedding matrix. These bubbles are electric versions of magnetic skyrmions, and are more than just a rarity; they constitute a novel quasiparticle in their own right. Recent experimental observations and successful manipulation attempts have set the stage. Yet, their dynamical behaviour remains a largely unexplored frontier. Lately our group at LIST predicted that electric bubbles will display Brownian motion and that this motion can be harnessed to produce bubble currents.
We offer you a postdoc position in the project “Bubblaced”, led by Hugo Aramberri (hugo.aramberri@list.lu), and focused on the modelling of electric bubble quasiparticles. You will join the ongoing work by Hugo Aramberri and Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) on understanding these objects using second-principles atomistic simulation methods, focusing on their dynamics and possible ways to act on them. You will also benefit from interactions with other team members. Join us in exploring the fascinating world of electric bubbles!

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
• You hold a PhD in Condensed Matter Physics, Materials Science, Computational Physics, Chemistry, or a closely related field.
• You have hands-on experience with atomistic modelling (DFT, second-principles, machine-learned force fields), scripting for automation and data analysis (e.g. Python, Bash), and working in a Linux/HPC environment. Knowledge of ferroelectricity and/or molecular dynamics is a strong asset.

• Fluency in English, both oral and written.

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/
You will join the Environmental Health (EH) group within the Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit at LIST. SUSTAIN conducts cross-disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society, combining expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation.
The Environmental Health group conducts cutting-edge research at the intersection of environmental toxicology, human health, and regulatory science, integrating in vitro toxicology, systems toxicology, exposure science, and sustainability assessment to develop next-generation tools and methods that inform decision-making and support the development of safe and sustainable products and policies.
This PhD position is embedded in the AIM-PACE project, which aims at developing a new generation of safe-and-sustainable-by-design, bio-based and circular plastics by combining AI, microbial technology, computer modelling, and polymer science. The PhD candidate is expected to support the operationalisation of the Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) framework, actively contribute to the Safety Assessment of the novel bio-based polymers and the integration of results for informed decision making along the life-cycle and innovation routes. Production of chemical safety data, primarily generated through in vitro New Approach Methodologies (NAMs), and computational modelling are expected to be key outcomes. The PhD candidate will combine experimental toxicology with computational approaches and scientific literature data to validate relevant case studies, supporting the identification of methodological gaps and challenges, and contributing to the advancement of SSbD approaches for bio-based materials.
The PhD will be co-supervised by Dr. Ivana Vinkovic (Institute for Medical Research and Occupational Health, Zagreb), a leading international expert in safety and toxicology assessment of advanced materials. Her research group performs cutting edge research at the nano-bio interface to identify opportunities and risks of nanomaterials and advanced materials at early stage of development, in a multidisciplinary environment covering chemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology, toxicology, risk assessment and regulatory science. In addition, it operates a high-impact testing platform for more tailored risk assessment and decision making which based on advanced biochemistry, immunology, toxicology, molecular and cell biology facilities. The academic supervisor will provide scientific guidance and mentorship throughout the doctoral research, support the development of the research plan, monitor progress, facilitate integration within the academic environment, and ensure compliance with the requirements of the PhD programme. The Faculty of Science, University of Zagreb, is one of the leading research and higher education institutions in Croatia, offering advanced training and research infrastructure in chemistry, biochemistry, nanotechnology, biosensors, environmental health, and biomedical sciences. The host group has expertise in Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) approaches, nanomaterials, advanced analytical methods, and translational biomedical research.

How will you contribute?
As a PhD Student within the AIM-PACE project, your main responsibilities will include:
• Supporting the scoping analysis of the AIM-PACE scenarios and products, as part of the SSbD framework implementation.
• Conducting a comprehensive literature review and data collection on hazard profiles of existing substances/materials and use of computational modelling for data gap filling.
• Identifying, reviewing and using models and tools for hazard screening, exposure assessment and risk assessment in the context of SSbD.
• Application of new approach methodologies (NAMs), including in vitro and computational tools, for hazard, exposure and risk assessment of AIM-PACE materials.
• Collaborating with project partners in integrating safety output with sustainability, techno-economic and social indicators.
• Collaborating with the team of Dr. Ivana Vinkovic Vrček to explore research activities, scientific training, conferences, and dissemination activities, and complete all doctoral requirements according to University of Zagreb regulations.
• Contributing to the dissemination of results through peer-reviewed scientific publications, conference presentations, and technical reports.
• Actively participating in AIM-PACE consortium activities, including meetings, workshops, and stakeholder engagement.

Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d)

Luxembourg
Line of Service Advisory
Industry/Sector Banking and Capital Markets
Specialism Fraud, Investigations & Regulatory Enforcement (FIRE)
Management Level Senior Associate

Job Description & Summary

PwC Luxembourg is hiring a Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d). What if it was you?

Your Mission:

In today's increasingly complex regulatory and financial environment, combating financial crime is a critical priority for all organisations. At our firm, the Financial Crime Compliance team acts as a strategic advisor to management and clients, proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks related to money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions breaches, fraud, and other financial crimes.

As a Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in delivering expert guidance, designing robust compliance frameworks, and supporting clients in implementing effective controls to safeguard their operations and reputation.
Be a part of our team where you will:

Client Risk Assessment and Advisory

• Conduct comprehensive financial crime risk assessments, covering AML, sanctions, fraud, and bribery/corruption risks;
• Advise clients on regulatory requirements and best practices under Luxembourg law, EU directives, FATF recommendations, and global standards;
• Assist in designing and implementing financial crime compliance frameworks tailored to client risk profiles.

Customer Due Diligence and Enhanced Due Diligence

• Review and analyze KYC documentation for new clients during onboarding;
• Perform ongoing due diligence and periodic reviews of existing client files;
• Conduct reputational checks and adverse media screening on clients and beneficial owners.

Transaction Monitoring and Investigations

• Design and implement transaction monitoring systems to detect suspicious activities across multiple risk typologies;
• Analyze transactional data to identify unusual patterns indicative of money laundering, fraud, or sanctions breaches;
• Support clients in investigating alerts and preparing Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) for competent authorities.

Sanctions and Screening Controls

• Implement and oversee sanctions screening processes, ensuring compliance with EU, UN, and OFAC lists;
• Review and validate screening results, investigate potential matches, and escalate confirmed hits;
• Advise clients on integrating sanctions screening tools and maintaining up-to-date watchlists.

Fraud and Bribery/Corruption Risk Management

• Assist clients in developing anti-fraud and anti-bribery policies and controls;
• Conduct fraud risk assessments and recommend mitigation measures;
• Support investigations into suspected fraud or corruption cases.

Monitoring, Reporting, and Regulatory Support

• Prepare compliance reports and dashboards for senior management and regulators;
• Support clients during regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring timely and accurate responses;
• Maintain and file confidential compliance documentation in accordance with legal requirements.

Training and Awareness

title: Telecom R&D Engineer - NTN (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:

Job Location:  LUXEMBOURG
Starting Date:  Start Immediately
Job Type:  UNLIMITED

Telecom R&D Engineer - NTN

With our groundbreaking satellite 5G constellation, OQ Technology is a global leader in IoT connectivity and next-generation satellite communication services. As a venture-backed company with a proven track record of satellite launches, we are the first in the world to integrate cellular 5G with satellites, enabling seamless connectivity for devices in remote and underserved regions. Our technology supports transformative applications across industries such as Oil & Gas, Maritime, Industry 4.0, and Transport, extending reliable connectivity through Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN). To support the continued development of our advanced telecommunications platform, we are looking for a Telecom R&D Engineer - NTN to join our team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and optimization of 3GPP-based protocol stacks and NTN adaptations for NB-IoT, LTE, and 5G NR technologies, helping bring cutting-edge satellite connectivity solutions from research to real-world deployment.

Key responsibilities

• Contribute to the research, development, and adaptation of L1/L2/L3 protocol stack components for Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) supporting NB-IoT, LTE, and 5G NR technologies.
• Participate in the full R&D lifecycle, including system design, implementation, integration, testing, and performance optimization.
• Analyze, troubleshoot, and enhance protocol stack behavior across multiple layers, including PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, and NAS.
• Investigate and implement NTN-specific adaptations required for satellite communications, including aspects related to propagation delay, Doppler effects, and timing synchronization.
• Design and execute testing and validation procedures, including unit testing, system integration testing, and performance benchmarking.
• Contribute to software integration and deployment workflows, including continuous integration and version control practices.
• Stay up to date with 3GPP standardization developments (e.g., NTN features in Releases 17/18/19) and contribute to translating standards into practical implementations.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including RF, FPGA, satellite systems, and platform engineering to integrate telecom stacks with hardware and system components.
• Support system-level analysis and debugging, including log analysis, KPI evaluation, and protocol trace inspection.

Basic qualifications

• An academic degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in telecom R&D, preferably working with 3GPP-based wireless systems.
• Solid understanding of 3GPP protocol architecture and procedures in NB-IoT, LTE, or 5G NR.
• Strong programming skills in C/C++, with additional scripting experience in Python for automation and analysis.
• Experience working in Linux/Unix environments with standard development and debugging tools.
• Familiarity with software development workflows, including version control (e.g., Git) and CI/CD practices. • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex system-level issues.
• Good communication and collaboration skills in a multidisciplinary engineering environment.
• Proficiency in spoken and written English.
• IMPORTANT: Candidate must already reside in Europe or hold a valid European residence permit.

Preferred skills and experience

• Hands-on experience with 3GPP wireless systems, particularly NB-IoT, LTE, or 5G NR implementations.
• Experience working with NTN architectures and protocol adaptations defined in 3GPP specifications.
• Practical experience analyzing and modifying protocol stack components across L1/L2/L3 layers (PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, NAS).
• Familiarity with core network signalling protocols, such as S1AP, NGAP, and GTP-C/U.
• Experience working with software-defined radio platforms (e.g., USRP) or open telecom stacks such as srsRAN and OpenAirInterface, or Open5GS and free5GC.
• Knowledge of O-RAN architecture and functional split concepts.
• Familiarity with Small Cell Forum (SCF) interfaces, including FAPI/nFAPI.
• Background in embedded or real-time software development, particularly on ARM-based or heterogeneous platforms.
• Experience with protocol debugging, KPI analysis, and system performance optimization in wireless communication systems.

Additional Information:  As part of the recruitment process, candidates may be required to provide a criminal record certificate issued within the last three (3) months.

What we offer:

• Enjoy a 50% income tax exemption on your salary – an exceptional incentive for top talent relocating to Luxembourg, subject to eligibility conditions.
• Flexibility to work remotely one day per week.
• Opportunity to work on flagship EU space mission projects.
• A dynamic, high-growth environment with career development opportunities.
• Regular company events and team activities.

title: Senior Unified Communications Engineer — Cisco & Microsoft Teams (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:

Ingénieur Senior en Communications Unifiées — Cisco & Microsoft Teams (H/F) — CDI à temps complet

Vous souhaitez rejoindre une société dynamique, leader sur son marché et disposant d'un large portefeuille de solutions ? XXXX Group est à la recherche d'un Ingénieur Senior en Communications Unifiées pour concevoir, déployer et supporter des environnements de téléphonie Cisco et Microsoft Teams avancés pour ses clients.

Mission

Vous intégrerez l'équipe UC Cisco & Applications de XXXX S.A. en tant qu'ingénieur senior, et prendrez en charge les solutions de Communications Unifiées Cisco et Microsoft Teams sur l'ensemble de leur cycle de vie — de l'architecture et la conception jusqu'à l'implémentation et le dépannage avancé.
Vous serez le référent technique et le point d'escalade pour les projets et incidents complexes, en intervenant à la fois sur nos propres plateformes et sur site chez nos clients au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région, dans un environnement professionnel exigeant nécessitant rigueur, autonomie, sens du service et bonne gestion des priorités.

Rôle principal

Dans le cadre de vos activités, vous serez notamment amené à:  

• Concevoir des solutions de communications unifiées (Cisco UC, SIP, Microsoft Teams) adaptées aux besoins des clients, en produisant des dossiers d'architecture de haut et bas niveau (HLD/LLD).
• Piloter l'implémentation et le déploiement des solutions UC:  clusters CUCM, passerelles voix, SBC/CUBE, trunks SIP, téléphones IP Cisco, Jabber/Webex, messagerie vocale et téléphonie Microsoft Teams.
• Définir et construire les plans de numérotation, le routage d'appels, les plans de numéros et les politiques de classe de service sur plusieurs sites.
• Agir comme point d'escalade de niveau 3:  diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents complexes voix, réseau et UC.
• Prendre en charge la sécurité UC:  certificats et PKI, TLS/SRTP, enregistrement sécurisé (CTL/ITL, clusters en mixed-mode) et prévention de la fraude téléphonique (toll fraud).
• Intégrer la UC à l'écosystème environnant:  AD/LDAP, présence, messagerie vocale, supervision et outils de ticketing.
• Piloter les migrations et montées de version, y compris les scénarios Cisco vers Teams et de téléphonie hybride.
• Assurer un leadership technique et le mentorat des techniciens et ingénieurs juniors, et contribuer aux bonnes pratiques internes.
• Assurer l'interface avec les clients, les fournisseurs et les équipes internes, en garantissant la qualité, une communication claire et le respect des délais projet.
• Produire et maintenir une documentation technique claire (dossiers de conception, configurations, as-built et procédures d'exploitation).

Profil recherché

Titulaire d'un diplôme de l'enseignement supérieur en informatique, réseaux ou télécommunications (niveau Bac+3 à Bac+5), ou justifiant d'une expérience professionnelle équivalente, vous disposez d'une expérience d'au moins 5 ans dans des projets de communications unifiées, dans un rôle combinant conception, implémentation et support.
Vous avez une capacité avérée à concevoir une solution, à l'implémenter et à la dépanner de bout en bout, et vous êtes à l'aise pour travailler en autonomie dans un environnement structuré et orienté client, avec un haut niveau d'exigence. Vous savez gérer les priorités et garder une communication professionnelle et claire en toute circonstance.
Les certifications Cisco (CCNP Collaboration / CCIE Collaboration) sont fortement appréciées ; les certifications Microsoft (Teams / Microsoft 365) sont un plus.

Compétences

• L'expertise Cisco Unified Communications est obligatoire : connaissance approfondie de CUCM, Unity Connection, IM&P, Jabber, Webex, téléphones IP Cisco, passerelles voix et SBC/CUBE.
• Maîtrise approfondie du protocole SIP (signalisation, négociation SDP, dépannage) et des flux média RTP/SRTP.
• Solides connaissances en sécurité UC et gestion des certificats: TLS, SRTP, PKI et gestion des certificats, enregistrement sécurisé (CTL/ITL), clusters en mixed-mode et lutte contre la fraude téléphonique.
• Socle réseau IT solide: TCP/IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, routage et QoS voix de bout en bout.
• La téléphonie Microsoft Teams est idéale: Teams Phone, Direct Routing, intégration SBC, politiques de routage voix et scénarios hybrides Cisco/Teams.
• Conception et ingénierie de solutions : design de plan de numérotation, haute disponibilité et redondance, Call Admission Control et dimensionnement.
• Dépannage avancé à l'aide des traces SIP/SDL, de RTMT, du Dialed Number Analyzer et de captures réseau (Wireshark).
• Compétences en gestion de projet et en documentation : capacité à piloter des projets techniques et à produire une documentation claire et structurée.

Langues

• Maîtrise du français requise, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
• Bon niveau d'anglais requis (documentation et échanges techniques).
• La maîtrise du luxembourgeois est un atout.

Environnement de travail

Le poste est basé au Luxembourg et combine des activités de projet et de conception avec des interventions sur site chez nos clients au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement où la qualité de service, la réactivité, la précision et la communication sont essentielles.
Ce poste conviendra à un professionnel expérimenté souhaitant prendre en charge des projets complexes de communications unifiées, approfondir son expertise sur les solutions

Cisco et Microsoft, et devenir un référent technique au sein d'un intégrateur ICT de premier plan.

Ce que nous proposons

• Un CDI à temps complet.
• Un package attractif.
• Un cycle continu de formation et la possibilité d'évoluer dans l'entreprise.
• Une équipe dynamique et soudée créant un cadre de travail très agréable.
• Une société où l'employé et le client sont au cœur de toutes les attentions.
• Un groupe leader dont le siège au Luxembourg facilite l'adéquation entre organisation, solutions et attente du marché.

Contraintes éventuelles liées au poste:  Extrait de casier judiciaire exigé

À propos de XXXX Group

Fondé en 1929 au Luxembourg, XXXX Group compte actuellement plus de 150 collaborateurs dans de multiples domaines d'activités et actifs dans les secteurs de la finance (agrément PSF), la santé, l'hôtellerie, l'industrie, les services, le secteur public et les Institutions européennes.
XXXX Group (XXXX, XXXX Security, XXXX Telecom et XXXX Soft) fournit des solutions d'intégration ICT, de services Cloud, de sécurité des bâtiments, d'intégration audiovisuelle et d'opérateur téléphonique au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région ainsi qu'une large palette de solutions IT et un service d'éditeur d'applications métiers.
Nous accompagnons les administrations, les grandes entreprises et les PME avec la même vision claire : se poser en partenaire fiable, flexible et innovant.

Comment postuler
Vous possédez les qualités requises ci-dessus? Veuillez s'il vous plaît envoyer votre lettre de motivation et votre curriculum vitae (en français ou en anglais) à l'adresse jobs@XXXX.com en indiquant « Candidature au poste d'Ingénieur Senior en Communications Unifiées (H/F) ».
Votre candidature sera traitée en toute confidentialité.

· Learning is driven by curiosity, compassion, and connection

· Students are empowered to find their voice and shape their future

As a French Language B Teacher, you will guide students in developing their language acquisition skills and intercultural understanding through the IB DP and MYP frameworks. · Design and facilitate engaging, inquiry-based learning experiences in French Language B across DP and MYP

· Teach and support learners in developing French language acquisition, communication skills, and intercultural understanding
· Create inclusive, differentiated learning environments that support diverse learners

· Contributing to the wellbeing and pastoral life of the school, including serving as a student advisor.
· Taking active part in the vibrant life of the school — from parent evenings to community events to leading beyond-the-classroom activities.
· Engage with AI effectively in guiding learners by having a human-centered mindset, promoting ethical principles and responsible use, and providing the knowledge, understanding and skills needed to create and use AI to complement their education.
What will you bring?

● Experience teaching IB DP French Language Acquisition and/or MYP French Language B;
● Experience preparing students for IB assessments;
● A recognised teaching qualification and relevant university degree (MA preferred);
● High-level proficiency in French appropriate for teaching Language B;
● Strong skills in inquiry-based, student-centred and differentiated teaching;
● The ability to create inclusive learning experiences for multilingual learners with diverse strengths and needs;
● Strong communication, collaboration and relationship-building skills;
● A reflective, culturally responsive and internationally minded approach to teaching and learning;

● Experience preparing students for IGCSE assessments;
● Experience teaching within an international and multilingual school community;
● Experience integrating educational technology and AI thoughtfully into language learning;
● Contributions to advisory, pastoral, co-curricular or beyond-the-classroom programmes.

Sous la responsabilité du Chef d'équipe Production, vous contribuez à la transformation des matières premières en produits finis dans le respect des standards de qualité, d'hygiène, de sécurité et de performance industrielle.
Ce poste vous offre une réelle polyvalence au cœur de l'atelier : vous intervenez sur différentes étapes de la production et pouvez être amené(e) à occuper plusieurs postes selon les besoins. Cette diversité des tâches vous permet de développer vos compétences, de gagner en autonomie et de jouer un rôle clé dans la fluidité de la production.

Vos principales responsabilités:

Production

• Assurer la conduite et la surveillance des équipements d'extrusion.
• Effectuer le suivi des paramètres de production et signaler toute anomalie.
• Veiller au respect des objectifs de production, de qualité et de rendement.
• Réaliser les changements de production selon les procédures établies.

Contrôle qualité

• Effectuer les contrôles horaires des produits en cours de fabrication.
• Réaliser et enregistrer les résultats des contrôles dans le système de gestion de la qualité.
• Prélever des échantillons et effectuer des analyses simples au laboratoire de production:
• Identifier les écarts de qualité et informer la hiérarchie en cas de non-conformité.

Gestion des matières premières

• Assurer le vidage et l'approvisionnement des matières premières nécessaires à la production.
• Contrôler la disponibilité et la conformité des matières utilisées.
• Participer à la gestion des stocks de matières premières selon les procédures en vigueur.

Packaging et préparation de commandes

• Réaliser les opérations de conditionnement et d'emballage des produits finis.
• Vérifier la conformité de l'étiquetage et du conditionnement.
• Préparer les commandes selon les instructions de production et les exigences clients.
• Assurer la traçabilité des produits emballés.

Entretien et nettoyage

• Effectuer le nettoyage régulier des équipements, des postes de travail et des zones de production.
• Respecter les procédures d'hygiène, de sécurité et de nettoyage en vigueur.
• Participer aux opérations de maintenance de premier niveau.

Conditions particulières

• Travail posté selon les besoins de la production.
• Port des équipements de protection individuelle obligatoire.
• Respect strict des procédures qualité, sécurité et hygiène.

Perspectives d'évolution

Ce poste offre une réelle perspective d'évolution vers une fonction de Chef d'équipe Production.
Selon votre engagement, votre maîtrise des équipements et votre capacité à coordonner les activités de production, vous pourrez progressivement évoluer vers un rôle à responsabilités comprenant:

• Encadrement opérationnel d'une équipe de production
• Organisation et suivi des plannings de fabrication
• Coordination des changements de production
• Support technique et organisationnel aux opérateurs
• Contribution active à la performance globale de la ligne

Un accompagnement interne et des formations pourront être proposés afin de soutenir cette évolution.

Compétences requises

• Formation technique, industrielle ou agroalimentaire (ou expérience équivalente)
• Une première expérience en production est un atout, mais non obligatoire
• Vous êtes rigoureux(se), impliqué(e) et appréciez le travail en équipe
• Vous avez le sens des responsabilités et de la qualité
• Vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement industriel structuré
• Vous êtes disponible pour travailler en horaires postés
• Vous maîtrisez le français
• L'anglais et/ou l'allemand constitue un avantage

Nous offrons

• Une entreprise familiale solide et reconnue au niveau européen
• Un environnement industriel moderne en pleine évolution
• Un poste concret, formateur et polyvalent
• Une formation complète à nos procédés et équipements
• Une équipe engagée et un management de proximité
• Une véritable opportunité d'évolution vers un poste de Chef d'équipe Production

title: Risk Officer - Vistra Funds Solutions (m/f)
description:
Job Title:  Risk Officer - Vistra Funds Solutions

Job Description:  
It's never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.  

At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction. But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we're absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that
 
We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as Risk Manager. Reporting to the Managing Director, this full-time and permanent position is based in Luxembourg and offers regional coverage, allowing you to make a significant impact to our Operations and its' growth.

Purpose of the Role

The Risk Officer supports the permanent risk management function under the direction of the Conducting Officer and contributes to the effective implementation and ongoing enhancement of the risk management framework for alternative investment funds across liquid and illiquid strategies.

The role involves monitoring investment and operational risks, overseeing risk limits and controls, supporting regulatory and internal reporting obligations, including Annex IV reporting, and ensuring timely escalation of relevant risk matters where appropriate.

The successful candidate will work closely with internal IFM functions and external stakeholders, including valuation, portfolio management delegates, compliance, and oversight functions, to promote effective risk governance and transparent communication across the organisation.

The position requires strong analytical and organisational capabilities, a good command of risk system applications and reporting tools, and a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset.

The Risk Officer is expected to contribute actively to the continuous development and optimisation of risk processes and controls, demonstrating flexibility, collaboration, and clear communication skills in a dynamic environment. Exposure to UCITS risk management frameworks would be considered an advantage.

Key Responsibilities

Risk monitoring for alternative investment funds

• Support the implementation and ongoing maintenance of the risk management framework for alternative investment funds across liquid and illiquid strategies, including risk monitoring, controls, and limit oversight.
• Perform regular risk reporting activities, including contribution to Annex IV reporting, escalation of breaches or anomalies, and maintenance of accurate risk data within risk management systems.
• Contribute to the enhancement of risk management processes, systems, and operational procedures by identifying practical improvements and supporting the implementation of efficient and scalable solutions
• Responsible of the accuracy and timeliness in the production of risk assessment, analysis and reporting including annex IV.
• Perform the monitoring of investment compliance of the AIFs
• Support the development and enhancement of internally developed risk IT tools, including testing of new reporting solutions, data aggregation processes, controls, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure the accuracy and reliability of risk analytics and reporting.

Client management

• Serve as a key contact for clients on risk management matters, ensuring appropriate escalation of relevant issues to senior members of the permanent risk management function. Support the delivery of regular client reporting and communication on risk exposures, risk monitoring, and related risk management matters, while responding to client queries in a timely and professional manner.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Liaise effectively with internal IFM functions including portfolio management, valuation, compliance, to ensure consistent risk governance and information flow. Present risk findings and reports to AIF senior management.
  
Attributes/Technical Skills

• Good knowledge of alternative investment fund risk management frameworks for liquid and illiquid strategies.
• Understanding of AIFMD regulatory requirements and Annex IV reporting obligations.
• Experience with risk monitoring tools, limit management systems, and risk reporting applications Knowledge of market, liquidity, counterparty, leverage, and operational risk measurement methodologies.
• Ability to analyse and interpret portfolio risk metrics and exposure reports.
• Familiarity with data aggregation, reconciliation controls, and risk data quality processes
• Exposure to user acceptance testing (UAT) and enhancement of internally developed risk systems and reporting tools
• Good command of Excel and risk reporting tools; knowledge of Power BI, SQL, or data visualisation tools would be an advantage
• Understanding of fund structures, valuation processes, and delegated portfolio management oversight within an IFM/AIFM environment
• Ability to identify control gaps and contribute to process improvement initiatives in a regulated environment.

Relevant Experience

• Minimum 3 year of experience and strong background in similar role managing risk for AIFs
• Demonstrated expertise in risk management system and reporting operations.

Education and Professional Qualification

• Bachelor's degree in finance, Economics, Business, Mathematics, or a related field.
• Advanced degree or relevant professional certification (e.g., GFR, FRM and CAIA) is a plus

title: HR Business Partner (m/f)
employer: Sometimes, Sàrl - Crèches Rockids S.A R.L.
description:
HR Business Partner (M/W)

Rockids, a network of nurseries operated by the La Maison Bleue Group, supports children and their families every day through a caring, innovative educational approach focused on children's development. Rockids is a recognized leader in the early childhood sector and operates 24 small-scale centers across Luxembourg, where quality of care, educational excellence, and staff well-being are at the heart of every project.
Joining Rockids means becoming part of a leading international group in the early childhood sector while working within a local, close-knit organization.

As an HR Business Partner, you will help shape the company's HR practices, support managers in their day-to-day challenges, and foster a high-performing work environment that promotes employee development.

Your primary mission will be to support the company's growth by implementing and continuously improving the HR processes that underpin its development.

As a true partner to senior management and teams, you will work across a broad range of responsibilities, including recruitment, HR development, HR administration, project management, and employee relations.

Your Role and Responsibilities

Recruitment and Onboarding

You will be responsible for the full recruitment process, from identifying staffing needs to onboarding new employees.
In this role, you will:

• Analyze hiring needs with facility directors and managers, taking into account staffing levels, operational requirements, and regulatory staff-to-resident ratios.
• Define candidate profiles and draft job descriptions and job postings.
• Post job openings and develop new recruitment channels.
• Proactively propose initiatives to strengthen the Group's attractiveness and employer brand.
• Conduct telephone pre-screenings for key roles across our facilities, including educational assistants, care assistants, educators, and facility managers.
• Conduct interviews and support managers throughout the recruitment process.
• Take a direct role in critical or sensitive hires and support less experienced managers in conducting interviews.
• Support newly appointed department heads as they develop their recruitment skills.
• Manage the administrative follow-up of applications.
• Coordinate the onboarding of new employees and monitor their probationary periods.

Supporting Managers and Teams

As a partner to managers and teams, you will support them in addressing their day-to-day HR challenges.

In particular, you will:

• Provide HR oversight and support to teams.
• Monitor and address absenteeism and turnover.
• Advise managers on disciplinary matters.
• Support skills development and employee development initiatives.
• Support the implementation of HR policies and procedures.
• Provide managers with practical HR advice tailored to operational realities and the specific needs of each location.

HR Administration

Working closely with our third-party service providers and internal teams, you will ensure the reliability and smooth execution of HR administrative processes.

Specifically, you will be responsible for:

• Managing payroll processes, including preparing and submitting payroll data and generating monthly reports.
• Preparing employment contracts and contract amendments.
• Managing and maintaining the HRIS.
• Monitoring administrative procedures related to medical examinations and other regulatory requirements.
• Coordinating end-of-contract procedures.
• Maintaining relationships with our payroll service provider, government authorities, and other HR service providers.

HR Management and Reporting

You will contribute to the effective management of the HR function by producing and analyzing HR data.

Specifically, you will be responsible for:

• Maintaining HR dashboards and ensuring the accuracy and reliability of HR data, including turnover and absenteeism figures.
• Analyzing key HR metrics related to absenteeism, turnover, recruitment, and payroll costs.
• Identifying trends and areas of concern and proposing appropriate corrective actions.
• Preparing HR reports and presentations for senior management.
• Developing new HR metrics and reporting tools based on the Group's needs.

HR Projects

You will play an active role in shaping and developing the Group's HR strategy and policies.

In particular, you will:

• Contribute to defining and implementing the HR strategy.
• Structure and continuously improve HR processes, particularly in the areas of recruitment and onboarding.
• Oversee the onboarding process for new employees.
• Implement and monitor training and skills development programs.
• Participate in interview campaigns and performance review processes.
• Contribute to the development of the employer brand and internal communications.
• Conduct employee engagement and satisfaction surveys, analyze the results, and propose action plans.
• Participate in discussions regarding salary structures and compensation, in collaboration with senior management.
• Support the implementation of new HR tools and processes.
• Proactively suggest initiatives to improve the employee experience.

Compliance and HR Monitoring

You will ensure compliance with the legal and regulatory framework applicable to the company and will:
• Monitor developments in employment law and HR regulations.
• Collaborate with our law firm and external partners on matters requiring specific expertise.
• Support management in handling sensitive individual employee situations.

Your Profile

We are looking for an HR professional with at least 3 years of experience in a generalist HR role or as an HR Business Partner, ideally in a multi-site environment.
You have a solid understanding of HR practices and are comfortable working across the key areas of the HR function.

Qualifications and Skills

You are known for:

• Your independence and strong sense of responsibility.
• Your ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
• Your attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
• Your analytical and problem-solving abilities, as well as your ability to synthesize information.
• Your excellent interpersonal skills and ability to build trusting relationships with managers and colleagues.
• Your pragmatic, solution-oriented approach.
• Your discretion and commitment to confidentiality.
• Your ability to stay connected to operational realities while providing proactive insights and recommendations to senior management.

Technical Skills

• A higher education degree in Human Resources, Management, Employment Law, or a related field.
• At least 3 years of experience in a generalist HR or HR Business Partner role.
• A strong understanding of employment law and operational HR practices.
• Excellent proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, including dashboards, KPI tracking, and reporting.
• Proficiency in digital tools and HR information systems (GesperPersonnel).
• Fluency in French and English, both written and spoken.
• Experience working in a multi-site environment is highly desirable.

Working Conditions

• Position based at Rockids' headquarters in Luxembourg, reporting directly to senior management.
• Flexible working hours, free meals and parking, company car, and performance-based bonus.

Why Join Us?

• Grow alongside a committed, multidisciplinary local leadership team at the heart of the company's governance and transformation.
• Join a leading international group in the early childhood sector with a strong local presence.
• Take on a position of responsibility offering genuine autonomy and a broad range of responsibilities.
• Gain cross-functional experience by working with teams across the La Maison Bleue Group in France, England, and Switzerland.

title: Research Scientist in Economics of Sustainability (m/f)
description:
Description:


Language: English (UK)
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Luxembourg Centre for Socio-Environmental Systems
Job Number: UOL08508
Contract Type: Permanent
Expected Start Date: 01/11/2026

Job Level: level 1
Functions: Researcher
Role Type: Cluster
Expertise: Researcher / Postdoctorant
Job (internal): Research scientist


Your role:

The successful candidate will establish internationally visible research at the interface of economics, sustainability science and global environmental change, developing new quantitative approaches to understand and steer transformations across food, land, water and natural-resource systems.
The candidate's research will combine economic theory, fine-scale spatial data, empirical evidence and computational modelling to explain trade-offs, synergies and spillovers that remain hidden in single-scale analyses. Relevant research may address at least three of the following fields: agricultural production, labor markets, natural-resource scarcity, food security, climate change, technological change, impacts of demographic transition, social cohesion, resilience of supply chains, environmental policy, and the distributional consequences of sustainability transformations.
A key ambition is to move beyond diagnosing unsustainable trajectories towards designing effective and equitable transformation pathways, exploring how policy, innovation and global interconnectedness can reconcile environmental sustainability with food security, livelihoods and economic development.


Your profile:

The successful candidate holds a strong academic background in economics, agricultural or environmental economics, together with an internationally recognized research record. They have demonstrated expertise in economic theory and quantitative modelling, complemented by experience with spatially explicit data, empirical estimation, computational methods or other approaches capable of linking processes across scales.
Additionally, they can translate theoretical concepts into transparent, empirically grounded models and integrate economic analysis with insights and data from other disciplines. Experience in interdisciplinary research on food, land, water, climate, natural resources or related sustainability challenges can be proven by documented participation within interdisciplinary networks and projects.
The successful candidate is an intellectually independent researcher with the ambition to build a collaborative, interdisciplinary research team, attract competitive research funding, develop innovative methodological approaches and contribute to policy-relevant sustainability science. A commitment to open, reproducible research, excellent communication across disciplinary boundaries, and the ability to engage effectively with policy and practice are essential.


The ideal candidate will have:

• A PhD in a relevant field and a minimum of 4 years Postdoc experience demonstrating ability to independently develop a research agenda
• A strong capability to think out of the box and shape their research around the challenges posed by interdisciplinary questions
• A strong record of research excellence, evidenced by impactful publications and success in securing external research funding
• Willingness to contribute to teaching programmes at the undergraduate and graduate levels in areas related to environmental change and socio-environmental systems


Language requirements:

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired for this position must have an excellent command of English. The University encourages its staff to learn additional languages and provides access to language courses to this end.


We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance


How to apply:

Applications should contain:

• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable


All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception.

In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, diversity and a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of everybody is respected. The University is committed to achieving gender parity among its academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

title: Data and Process Manager for our International Non-Life team (m/f)
description:
Data and Process Manager for our International Non-Life team

Location  Leudelange
Experience Level  Experienced
Home Office  Yes, partially possible

Your Job in a Nutshell

• Within our International Non-Life department, we are building a new Pan-European business branch operating under the Freedom of Service (FoS) regime.
• Our ambition: bring innovative insurance solutions to B2B partners across Europe — from MGAs and brokers to corporate clients seeking fronting solutions for their captives.
• As Data and Process Manager, you will play a key role in structuring and supervising the entire data process exchange for our international operations.
• You will also be in charge of building processes and optimizing them to create the most efficient organization. You will ensure that data provided by third-party are handled efficiently, compliantly, and in line with Baloise's best practices — a cornerstone of our competitiveness.
• You will work within a multidisciplinary international team operating in start-up and agile mode, reporting directly to the Head of International Non-Life.
• You will be part of an international team shaping a new line of business within a stable and reputable insurance group, with the opportunity to make a tangible impact on our European growth story.

What you can expect

Your main missions will be to:

Financial Management and Data Quality:

• Manage operational financial flows and work closely with Finance teams to ensure the timely and accurate transmission of data.
• Ensure the consistency and reliability of technical and financial data, notably by overseeing proper data reconciliation with actuarial teams and collaborating with partners to enhance the integrity of incoming data flows.

Operational and Cross-Functional Support:

• Coordinate operations across internal teams and external partners.
• Support claims management, fraud investigations, and customer complaints handling, while assisting in the design and deployment of operational processes with partners.
• Collaborate with legal and technical stakeholders whenever required.
• Take ownership of cross-functional topics and urgent requests that have not yet been allocated within the team, stepping in where necessary to ensure business continuity and the successful delivery of activities across functions.
Process Management and Cross-Functional Coordination:
• Define, formalize, document, and continuously improve business processes, including underwriting, claims management, data flows, and reporting.
• Actively manage workflow automation and digitalization initiatives in close collaboration with IT and data teams.
• Ensure that processes comply with applicable regulatory requirements.
• Identify operational pain points and drive problem-solving and process optimization initiatives.

title: Software Development Engineer (ML), EU International Technologies (m/f)
description:
Software Development Engineer (ML), EU International Technologies
Job ID: 10566721 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

As an engineer on our team, you will take on a key role in improving capabilities of the Amazon product search service, and ensure we offer top-quality recommendations for all our customers regardless of their location or language. We help customers find the products they are searching for, and discover new products they would be interested in, by developing ML models trained on terabytes of product and traffic data to improve query understanding, ranking of search results, and personalization. We are seeking a software engineer who will assist in deploying those ML models, integrating them into existing services, and optimizing their performance. You will do so by building robust pipelines to train, evaluate, and deploy our models.

This is a rewarding role where you will be able to draw a clear connection between your work and how it improves the experience of millions of Amazon customers across the globe every day. You can also expect to have excellent opportunities, and ample support, for career growth, development, and mentorship. The team is a mixed science/engineering group, with each team member able to contribute to both engineering excellence as well as scientific innovation.

Key job responsibilities

- Design and implement new features across the various software components powering our search system
- Participate in the design and deployment of robust and scalable pipelines for data processing, model training, and model inference
- Build and configure metrics, dashboards, and alerting mechanisms for our deployed services and models
- Work closely with ML experts on your team to identify improvement opportunities and tackle technical obstacles
- Coordinate with engineering counterparts in other teams and stakeholders we work with

A day in the life

You will collaborate with scientists who build ML models trained on terabytes of data, and integrate these models into the production search engine that serves customers, closing the loop through design, implementation, deployment, and monitoring. The chosen approaches for model architecture will balance business-defined performance metrics with the needs of millisecond response times.

About the team

EU International Technologies is an organization focused on accelerating the EU Stores business by delighting customers and selling partners. The team's mission is to innovate locally and scale worldwide, fostering a world-class community of builders that delivers with speed and agility. EU INTech operates across domains including consumer discovery, search, selection, partner growth, pricing, sustainability, and marketplace expansion. The culture emphasizes collaboration, inclusion, technical excellence, big bets on high-impact projects, transparency, and long-term ownership -- empowering engineers and scientists to solve complex problems at international scale.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related quantitative field
- 3+ years of professional software development experience
- 1+ year of experience in building large-scale pipelines for data processing and ML model training/inference
- Strong coding and problem-solving skills in at least one modern programming language such as Python, Java, C++, etc.
- A general understanding of essential machine learning concepts (with no expectation of in-depth ML knowledge)
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including code reviews, build processes, testing, and deployment

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in computer science or a related quantitative field
- Professional experience with AWS services (e.g. S3, EC2, Lambda, EMR, DynamoDB)
- Prior experience within a multidisciplinary team of scientists and engineers
- Experience with NLP applications or search/retrieval engines
- Fluency in one or more languages other than English

title: (Senior) Risk Manager*in (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
employer: Commerz Real AG Commerz Real Düsseldorf
description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager*in

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real AG ist der Asset Manager der Commerzbank Gruppe und verfügt über 50 Jahre internationale Markterfahrung. Das Unternehmen vereint umfassendes Know-how im Asset Management mit breiter Strukturierungsexpertise und entwickelt daraus sachwertorientierte Fondsprodukte sowie maßgeschneiderte Investmentlösungen in den Bereichen Immobilien und Infrastruktur. Als Leasingdienstleister des Commerzbank-Konzerns bietet die Commerz Leasing zudem bedarfsgerechte Leasingkonzepte. Seit 2025 sind die Asset-Management-Beteiligungen der Commerzbank Gruppe bei der Commerz Real AG gebündelt. Neben den Marken und Produkten der Commerz Real zählen dazu die Aquila Capital Investmentgesellschaft mit Fokus auf nachhaltige Sachwertinvestments im Bereich Energieinfrastruktur sowie Yellowfin Asset Management als Boutique für liquide Investmentstrategien. Unter dem Dach der Commerz Real AG verwalten insgesamt rund 1.000 Mitarbeitende an rund 20 Standorten Vermögenswerte von rund 55 Milliarden Euro.

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
- Du übernimmst Coaching / Weiterbildungsaufgaben im Risikomanagement sowie die Ausbildung von Nachwuchskräften

Profil:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (auch berufsintegriertes) Studium mit der Fachrichtung Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise im Schwerpunkt Risikomanagement
- Langjährige fachbezogene Berufserfahrung im Bereich Risikomanagement eines Asset-Managers, eines Fondsemissionshauses oder eines Kreditinstitutes,
- Umfassende Kenntnisse und mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Assetklasse Infrastructure, idealerweise auch in Private Equity und Debt Strukturen. Grundkenntnisse und Interesse an den Assetklassen Renewable Energies, sowie Real Estate runden Deine Erfahrung ab.
- Erweiterte betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse insbesondere im Bereich Risikomanagement, Bilanzanalyse, Discounted Cash-Flow-Analyse, Sensitivitätsanalyse, Cash-Flow-Modellierung, Liquiditätsrisikomanagement und Portfoliosteuerung
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)
- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr sicherer Umgang mit MS Office
- Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise auch gute Französischkenntnisse
- Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Hohes Maß an Zielstrebigkeit und Eigeninitiative sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Flexibilität

• Our European offices, our headquarters in Seattle, as well as where we operate around the world

Important Notes

• You need only to submit one Amazon job application for all roles listed below (please use your school e-mail).
• We are looking for candidates who want to own, build and impact the customer experience over being tied to a specific role or team. The role and team placement will be based on business needs and as Amazon continues to grow we cannot guarantee that you will be based in the location or business area of your choice, but we will do our best to take your preferences into account.

Key job responsibilities

Launch, Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe, recruits top MBA international talent and builds broad, adaptable Amazonians across corporate businesses in Europe. The program provides a platform for MBAs to make the successful transition from their pre-MBA experience to Amazon. We run a three-year program offering two job rotations supported through on-boarding activities, core training modules, networking opportunities, and mentorship. Launch MBAs start by diving deep to understand customers and how the business is meeting their needs, then apply the learning from their MBA and their own creativity to identify the opportunities where they can make the biggest difference. At the end of the three-year program, MBAs have integrated into Amazon's peculiar ways and have acquired a diverse set of experiences that enable them to take ownership of their next career move through Amazon's extensive internal job opportunities. Through the rotation process, MBAs are able to move to a new function, business, and/or European location.

Opportunities within different business areas vary each year, and can include: Advertising, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Prime Video, Consumer and Devices/Alexa.

• Sr. Marketing Manager: Develop and execute strategies for growing the size and lifetime value of the business unit's customer base, through both acquisition and CRM strategies for targeting and communicating with customers.
• Sr. Product Manager: Support the definition and launch of new products, services, or features in partnership with technical teams. Evaluate the existing experience(s) for customers on and off Amazon, identify areas for improvement, develop business requirements, craft and implement marketing plans, and own measures of success.
• Sr. Program Manager: Find solutions to complex problems and innovate on leading edge solutions to manage programs broadly across businesses within Amazon. Given responsibility to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Drive efforts independently and as part of larger project teams, and have a significant impact on the customer experience and the business.
• Sr. Vendor Manager: Identify new brand and product business opportunities, manage relationships with key vendors, negotiate competitive business terms, and secure participation in promotions and marketing programs.

title: Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (h/f)
description:

Reference: LU879641
Luxembourg
Permanent
Legal and Professional Services

Notre client est un cabinet de conseil international fondé au début des années 2000 et aujourd'hui présent dans plusieurs pays européens.
Sa mission est d'accompagner les entreprises dans l'atteinte de leurs objectifs en délivrant des résultats mesurables et concrets.
Son expertise couvre l'excellence opérationnelle, l'optimisation de la supply chain, la data, la conduite du changement, la transformation digitale et la transition durable.

Le cabinet intervient auprès d'organisations de premier plan dans des secteurs variés tels que l'industrie, les sciences de la vie, le secteur public, les services financiers, le retail et la construction.
Dans un contexte où les transformations numériques s'accélèrent et où les DSI, CIO et CTO jouent un rôle croissant dans la définition de la stratégie des entreprises, notre client souhaite aujourd'hui franchir une nouvelle étape avec la création et le développement d'une practice CIO Advisory.

Cette practice a vocation à devenir un axe majeur du développement du cabinet, en accompagnant les dirigeants IT et les directions générales dans leurs réflexions et transformations stratégiques, organisationnelles et technologiques.
Pour accompagner sa croissance et participer à des projets de transformation et d'excellence opérationnelle, notre client recherche actuellement un(e) Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F).

Votre rôle

En tant que Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory, vous aurez la responsabilité de piloter et délivrer des missions de transformation IT à fort impact, tout en contribuant au développement de la practice, de son portefeuille clients et de ses équipes.
Vous interviendrez directement auprès des CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, de la définition des orientations jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre, avec une forte exigence de résultats, de qualité de delivery et d'impact durable.

Pilotage et delivery des missions clients

Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conduite et la réussite des missions de la practice :

• Piloter des missions complexes de stratégie et transformation IT, de leur cadrage jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre.
• Accompagner les clients dans la définition de leur vision cible IT et sa déclinaison en feuilles de route concrètes et opérationnelles.
• Superviser les diagnostics, analyses, recommandations et plans de transformation réalisés par les équipes.
• Challenger les organisations, processus, architectures et modes de fonctionnement IT afin d'identifier les leviers de performance et de transformation.
• Assurer la qualité des livrables, le respect des engagements et l'atteinte des résultats attendus.
• Intervenir directement auprès des instances de direction et accompagner les clients dans leurs décisions stratégiques.
• Sécuriser l'exécution des transformations et accompagner les équipes clients jusqu'à l'obtention de résultats durables.
Développement et structuration de la practice

En vous appuyant sur les besoins rencontrés sur le terrain, vous contribuerez à faire évoluer et structurer l'offre CIO Advisory :

• Développer des méthodologies et approches permettant de transformer l'expertise acquise en mission en offres structurées et réplicables.
• Identifier les nouvelles problématiques rencontrées par les CIO et faire évoluer l'offre en conséquence.
• Développer des synergies avec les autres expertises du cabinet : cybersécurité, data, ERP, cloud, transformation et excellence opérationnelle.
• Contribuer au positionnement et au développement de la practice au sein de mon client.
Développement commercial et relation client
Le développement commercial s'inscrira dans la continuité de votre activité de conseil et de votre proximité avec les clients :
• Développer des relations de confiance durables avec les CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales.
• Identifier de nouvelles opportunités à partir des enjeux et besoins rencontrés chez les clients.
• Construire et développer un portefeuille de missions CIO Advisory.
• Piloter les avant-ventes, propositions commerciales, appels d'offres et soutenances.
• Développer le cross-selling avec les autres practices et contribuer à la croissance du cabinet.

Leadership et développement des équipes

En tant que Directeur, vous serez également responsable de la qualité et du développement des équipes intervenant sur vos missions :

• Encadrer les équipes et leur apporter le niveau de guidance nécessaire à la réussite des missions.
• Challenger les analyses, recommandations et livrables afin de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence.
• Accompagner les consultants dans leur montée en compétences et leur capacité à prendre progressivement davantage de responsabilités en delivery.
• Transmettre votre expertise à travers le coaching, le mentoring et le partage d'expérience.
• Contribuer au recrutement et au développement des expertises nécessaires à la croissance de la practice.
• Développer une culture fondée sur l'excellence du delivery, le pragmatisme, la collaboration et l'obtention de résultats concrets.

Profil recherché

Nous recherchons avant tout un leader entrepreneurial, capable de combiner expertise technique, excellence du delivery et développement commercial.

Vous disposez idéalement de :

• Une formation de niveau Master (Bac+5), idéalement issue d'une école d'ingénieurs, d'une université ou d'une grande école avec une spécialisation IT, digitale ou technologique.
• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans le conseil, la transformation IT ou des environnements technologiques complexes.
• De solides compétences techniques et une forte compréhension des enjeux IT, vous permettant de challenger des architectures, des organisations, des choix technologiques et des trajectoires de transformation.
• Une expertise sur plusieurs dimensions du CIO Advisory : stratégie IT, operating model, cloud, infrastructures, architecture, cybersécurité, data, modernisation ou rationalisation des systèmes d'information.
• Une expérience significative dans le pilotage et le delivery de missions complexes, depuis le cadrage stratégique jusqu'à la mise en œuvre.
• Une expérience solide auprès de CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, avec la capacité à intervenir comme interlocuteur de confiance sur des problématiques stratégiques et techniques.
• Une réelle capacité à développer du business : identification d'opportunités, développement de comptes, construction de propositions commerciales, soutenances et développement de nouvelles missions.
• Une forte capacité à développer et entretenir des relations de confiance avec des décideurs de haut niveau.
• Un fort esprit entrepreneurial, avec l'envie de construire, structurer et faire grandir une activité.
• Une excellente communication, une forte posture de conseil et une capacité à embarquer clients et équipes.

title: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems (m/f)
description:
Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems

Position: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg
Start Date: Immediate
Type: Full-time

Company Overview

We're LuxQuantum, a Luxembourg-based deep-tech startup developing the next generation of quantum-safe communication systems.

Our mission is to address one of the key challenges in modern cybersecurity: how to combine Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) into a unified, adaptive, and scalable security architecture.

At LuxQuantum, we believe security decisions should not be static. Different data, infrastructures, risks, trust assumptions, and operational conditions may require different protection strategies. That's why we are developing intelligent and adaptive approaches to model these complex environments and support dynamic security and orchestration decisions.

Our work brings together AI, systems modeling, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications, creating research challenges that span multiple scientific and engineering disciplines.

We are a small and ambitious team of researchers, engineers, and innovators who enjoy exploring difficult problems, learning across disciplines, and turning research ideas into real-world technology.

Role Overview

As a Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer, you will contribute to the research and development of the intelligence and decision-making capabilities behind LuxQuantum's adaptive quantum-safe security systems.

You will investigate how complex security and communication systems can adapt to changing risks, uncertainty, trust requirements, infrastructure conditions, and operational constraints. Your work may involve mathematical and computational modeling, optimization, probabilistic methods, AI, or other data-driven and decision-support approaches.

You will work closely with our research and engineering team to formulate research problems, explore and compare different approaches, develop models and algorithms, evaluate them through experiments and simulations, and translate promising results into working prototypes.

The research sits at the intersection of systems modeling, intelligent decision-making, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications.

What You'll Do

• Investigate challenging research problems in intelligent and adaptive security systems
• Formulate research questions, develop new approaches, and design experiments and simulations to evaluate them
• Develop mathematical, computational, and AI-based models for decision-making under uncertainty, risk, and changing operational conditions
• Explore adaptive approaches for the orchestration and optimization of hybrid quantum-safe systems
• Design and evaluate methods that help security systems dynamically respond to changing infrastructure, trust, and operational requirements
• Translate research ideas, models, and algorithms into working prototypes and validate them in realistic scenarios

title: Senior Manager - Corporate Secretarial Services (COE) (m/f)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Manager - Corporate Secretarial Services (COE)
Co-Sec - Centre of Excellence - CD0404 - Senningerberg, Luxembourg (Hybrid)

About Waystone

Waystone is a leading asset-servicing solutions provider of institutional governance, administration, risk and compliance services to financial institutions. With over 25 years' experience and a comprehensive range of specialist services to its name, Waystone helps our clients structure, operate and grow through our expertise, innovation and digitisation, backed by the operational scale to support global expansion

Summary:

The Senior Manager - Corporate Secretarial Services (COE) will lead a team, leading delivery of services to a strategically important client, with a complex portfolio of underlying client entities and relationships. Key responsibilities include drafting, reviewing, implementing and refining controls, processes and procedures, manuals, trackers and billing controls, reviewing work produced by staff within teams based in the jurisdiction, supervising staff and enhancing operational efficiency. The role also involves assistance with recruitment, performance management, KPI monitoring and development, project and technology management and assistance across the wider Corporate Secretarial Services team.

Key responsibilities:

Operations and controls

• Draft, implement, review and refine controls, processes, procedures, manuals, trackers and billing controls for the team and the wider Corporate Secretarial Services team;
• Own team KPI reporting and performance outcomes, identifying trends, implementing corrective actions and driving continuous improvement and reporting to management and/or clients;
• Be responsible for invoicing in respect of the team's services;
• Lead and manage projects impacting team operations;
• Drive the adoption, optimisation and governance of entity management systems, board portals and other technology solutions to improve efficiency and service quality.

Delivery of services

• Take on Corporate Secretarial Services related tasks for flagship clients;
• Support and/ or oversee board support activities, including meeting organisation, coordination with attendees, preparation, distribution and/or review of materials, draft and/or review minutes, manage post-meeting actions and draft and/or review resolutions;
• Demonstrate deep knowledge of fund corporate governance and regulatory filing requirements, staying informed of relevant changes;
• Manage administrative tasks by the team including regulatory filings, RBE register updates, RCS deposits, document execution and safekeeping and legalisation processes;

Client relationship management

• Responsible for a strategically significant client relationship, with a complex portfolio of underlying clients and stakeholders, including relationship development and ensuring high-quality service;
• Attend client meetings, pitches and service calls;

Team leadership

• Manage and oversee team performance and the team's operations, monitoring and directing activity within the team and ensuring delivery within the team's specified timeframes and procedures;
• Provide guidance, training and mentorship to team members and members of the wider Corporate Secretarial Services team;
• Support recruitment efforts for the teams in Luxembourg and the wider Corporate Secretarial team;
• Serve as the final escalation point for team queries;
• Monitor and assess the performance of direct reports, conducting appraisals, allocating work and associated line manager tasks.
• Build a high performing team, promoting employee engagement.

Requirements:

• You have 9+ years of experience in relevant, funds related, company secretarial roles;
• CGI, ILA or other relevant governance qualifications preferred;
• You have a proven track record leading teams;
• You have experience managing complex fund structures;
• You have experience implementing process improvement initiatives;
• You have experience with entity management and Board portal technology;
• You have a strong knowledge of Luxembourg corporate and fund regulations;
• You have excellent communication skills and attention to detail;
• You are fluent in English (written and spoken); fluency in English is sufficient for this role.

A la Banque de Luxembourg, nous desservons trois types de clients : les clients privés, les clients entreprises de type familial, et les clients professionnels issus des métiers de la gestion d'actifs.

Le département Informatique de la Banque de Luxembourg accompagne la banque - ainsi que d' autres entités de banques privées installées en Europe et en Asie - dans leurs projets de transformation et dans le développement de solutions innovantes.

• Maîtriser et assurer le paramétrage de ces solutions : gestion de la production, support, monitoring, testing et la standardisation des installations.

• Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français (min. C1) et disposez de connaissance en anglais (min. B2).

Convaincu·es que notre diversité fait notre force, nous sommes signataires de la Charte de la Diversité, Lëtzebuerg. Attentifs à l'égalité des chances, nous nous engageons à travers des actions concrètes, notamment en faveur des jeunes talents, des femmes, des collaborateurs seniors…
